function addABlock(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiAContainer");
    const div = document.createElement("div"); div.className="ref-block";
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="number" class="refA" placeholder="Réf. (€)" style="width:110px;" oninput="autoCalculA()">
        <input type="text" class="valsA" placeholder="Valeurs (ex: 90 150 120)" oninput="autoCalculA()">
        <button type="button" onclick="removeNode(this)">🗑️</button>
    `;
    cont.appendChild(div);
}

function autoCalculA(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiAContainer");
    const resDiv = document.getElementById("resultA"); 
    resDiv.innerHTML = "";
    
    Array.from(cont.getElementsByClassName("ref-block")).forEach((block, index) => {
        const ref = parseNumber(block.querySelector(".refA").value);
        const raw = (block.querySelector(".valsA").value || "").trim();
        if(raw === "") return;
        const vals = raw.split(/\s+/).map(parseNumber).filter(v => v !== null); 
        
        let html = `<div style="margin: 15px 0;"><h4>Bloc ${index + 1} - Référence : ${ref === null ? 'n/a': ref.toFixed(2)}€</h4>`;
        html += `<table style="width:100%;"><tr><th>Valeur</th><th>Différence</th><th>%</th></tr>`;
        
        vals.forEach(v => {
            const diff = ref === null ? v : v - ref;
            const pct = (ref === null || ref === 0) ? null : (diff / ref * 100);
            const col = diff > 0 ? "#2ecc71" : diff < 0 ? "#e74c3c" : "#95a5a6";
            html += `<tr style="background:${col}; color:#fff;">
                <td>${v.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                <td>${diff>=0?'+':''}${diff.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                <td>${pct===null? '—' : pct.toFixed(2)+'%'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += "</table></div>";
        resDiv.innerHTML += html;
    });
}

function addBBlock(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiBContainer");
    const div = document.createElement("div"); div.className="ref-block";
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="number" class="valeurB" placeholder="Départ (€)" style="width:110px;" oninput="autoCalculB()">
        <input type="text" class="pourcentB" placeholder="Pourcentages (ex: 10 -5 20)" oninput="autoCalculB()">
        <button type="button" onclick="removeNode(this)">🗑️</button>
    `;
    cont.appendChild(div);
}

function autoCalculB(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiBContainer");
    const resDiv = document.getElementById("resultB"); 
    resDiv.innerHTML = "";
    
    Array.from(cont.getElementsByClassName("ref-block")).forEach((block, index) => {
        const val = parseNumber(block.querySelector(".valeurB").value);
        const raw = (block.querySelector(".pourcentB").value || "").trim();
        if(raw === "") return;
        const taux = raw.split(/\s+/).map(parseNumber).filter(n => n !== null);
        
        let html = `<div style="margin: 15px 0;"><h4>Bloc ${index + 1} - Départ : ${val === null ? 'n/a' : val.toFixed(2)}€</h4>`;
        html += `<table style="width:100%;"><tr><th>Taux</th><th>Variation</th><th>Résultat</th></tr>`;
        
        taux.forEach(p => {
            const r = val * (1 + p/100);
            const variation = r - val;
            const col = p > 0 ? "#2ecc71" : p < 0 ? "#e74c3c" : "#95a5a6";
            html += `<tr style="background:${col}; color:#fff;">
                <td>${p}%</td>
                <td>${variation >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${variation.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                <td>${r.toFixed(2)} €</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += "</table></div>";
        resDiv.innerHTML += html;
    });
}

function addCBlock(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiCContainer");
    const div = document.createElement("div"); div.className = "ref-block";
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" class="valsC" placeholder="Valeurs (ex: 100 150 200)" oninput="autoCalculC()" style="width:120px;">
        <label style="color: inherit;">Max % : <input type="number" class="maxC" value="100" step="10" style="width:70px;" oninput="autoCalculC()"></label>
        <input type="range" class="rangeC" min="-100" max="100" value="20" step="1" oninput="autoCalculC()">
        <span class="pctDisplay">20%</span>
        <button type="button" onclick="removeNode(this)">🗑️</button>
    `;
    cont.appendChild(div);
    autoCalculC();
}

function autoCalculC(){
    const block = document.querySelector('#multiCContainer .ref-block:last-child');
    if (block) {
        const maxInput = block.querySelector(".maxC");
        const rangeInput = block.querySelector(".rangeC");
        const max = parseNumber(maxInput.value) || 100;
        rangeInput.min = -max;
        rangeInput.max = max;
        const pct = parseNumber(rangeInput.value) || 0;
        block.querySelector(".pctDisplay").innerText = pct + "%";
    }
    updateC();
}

function updateC(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiCContainer");
    let html = "";
    
    Array.from(cont.getElementsByClassName("ref-block")).forEach((block,i) => {
        const valsStr = (block.querySelector(".valsC")?.value || "").trim();
        const vals = valsStr ? valsStr.split(/\s+/).map(parseNumber).filter(v => v !== null) : [];
        const pct = parseNumber(block.querySelector(".rangeC")?.value) || 0;
        
        if(vals.length){
            html += `<div style="margin: 15px 0;"><h4>Bloc ${i+1} (${pct}%)</h4>`;
            html += `<table style="width:100%;"><tr><th>Valeur initiale</th><th>Variation</th><th>Résultat</th></tr>`;
            
            vals.forEach(v => {
                const r = v * (1 + pct/100);
                const variation = r - v;
                const col = pct > 0 ? "#2ecc71" : pct < 0 ? "#e74c3c" : "#95a5a6";
                html += `<tr style="background:${col}; color:#fff;">
                    <td>${v.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                    <td>${variation >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${variation.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                    <td>${r.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                </tr>`;
            });
            html += "</table></div>";
        }
    });
    
    document.getElementById("resultC").innerHTML = html;
}

/* =========================
    MODE D : ÉVOLUTION
    ========================= */
function addDDate(defaultDate = null) {
    if (!defaultDate) {
        const today = new Date();
        const yyyy = today.getFullYear();
        const mm = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const dd = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        defaultDate = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
    }
    const newDateId = Date.now() + Math.random();
    dDates.push({ id: newDateId, date: defaultDate });
    dSeries.forEach(s => { s.values[newDateId] = ''; });
    updateDTable();
}

function sortDDates() {
    dDates.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date).getTime() - new Date(b.date).getTime());
    updateDTable();
}

function addDSeries() {
    const count = dSeries.length + 1;
    const newSeriesId = Date.now() + Math.random();
    const colors = ["#3498db","#2ecc71","#e74c3c","#f1c40f","#9b59b6","#1abc9c"];
    
    const newSeries = { 
        id: newSeriesId, 
        label: `Série ${count}`, 
        color: colors[dSeries.length % colors.length], 
        values: {},
        visible: true
    };

    dDates.forEach(d => {
        newSeries.values[d.id] = '';
    });

    dSeries.push(newSeries);
    updateDTable();
}

function removeDDate(dateId) {
    dDates = dDates.filter(d => d.id !== dateId);
    dSeries.forEach(s => { delete s.values[dateId]; });
    updateDTable();
}

function updateDDateValue(dateId, newDateString) {
    const dateObj = dDates.find(d => d.id === dateId);
    if (dateObj) {
        dateObj.date = newDateString;
    }
    updateDTable(false);
}

function updateDValue(seriesId, dateId, value) {
    const series = dSeries.find(s => s.id === seriesId);
    if (series) {
        series.values[dateId] = parseNumber(value) || 0;
    }
    calculerD();
}

function updateDTable(recreate = true) {
    const dateHeaderRow = document.getElementById("dateHeaderRow");
    const seriesBody = document.getElementById("seriesBody");

    if(recreate) {
        dDates.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date).getTime() - new Date(b.date).getTime());
    }

    dateHeaderRow.innerHTML = '<th style="min-width: 160px;">Série / Date</th>';
    dDates.forEach(d => {
        const th = document.createElement('th');
        th.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px;">
                <input type="date" class="date-input-d" value="${d.date}" 
                       onchange="updateDDateValue(${d.id}, this.value)">
                <button type="button" onclick="removeDDate(${d.id})" style="padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 12px;">🗑️</button>
            </div>
        `;
        dateHeaderRow.appendChild(th);
    });
    
    seriesBody.innerHTML = '';
    dSeries.forEach((s, index) => {
        const tr = document.createElement('tr');
        tr.dataset.seriesId = s.id;

        const thSeries = document.createElement('th');
        thSeries.innerHTML = `
            <div class="series-header-d">
                <input type="text" class="series-name-input" value="${s.label}" 
                       oninput="updateDSeriesProp(${s.id}, 'label', this.value)" style="width:110px;">
                <input type="color" value="${s.color}" 
                       onchange="updateDSeriesProp(${s.id}, 'color', this.value)">
                <button type="button" onclick="removeDSeries(${s.id})" style="padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 12px;">🗑️</button>
            </div>
        `;
        thSeries.style.textAlign = 'left';
        tr.appendChild(thSeries);

        dDates.forEach(d => {
            const rawVal = s.values[d.id];
            const currentValue = rawVal !== null && rawVal !== undefined ? rawVal : '';
            
            const td = document.createElement('td');
            td.innerHTML = `<input type="number" class="value-input-d" placeholder="0" value="${currentValue}"
                                   oninput="updateDValue(${s.id}, ${d.id}, this.value)">`;
            tr.appendChild(td);
        });
        
        seriesBody.appendChild(tr);
    });
}

function removeDSeries(seriesId) {
    dSeries = dSeries.filter(s => s.id !== seriesId);
    updateDTable();
}

function updateDSeriesProp(seriesId, prop, value) {
    const series = dSeries.find(s => s.id === seriesId);
    if (series) {
        series[prop] = value;
    }
    calculerD();
}

function calculerD(){
    const canvasD = document.getElementById("graphD");
    const ctx = canvasD.getContext('2d');
    
    if (chartD) chartD.destroy();
    
    if (dDates.length === 0 || dSeries.length === 0) {
        canvasD.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    
    const labels = dDates.map(d => {
        const date = new Date(d.date);
        return date.toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' });
    });
    
    const datasets = [];
    dSeries.forEach((s) => {
        if (!s.visible) return;
        
        const dataPoints = [];
        dDates.forEach(d => {
            const val = parseNumber(s.values[d.id]);
            dataPoints.push(val !== null ? val : 0);
        });
        
        datasets.push({
            label: s.label,
            data: dataPoints,
            borderColor: s.color,
            backgroundColor: s.color + '40',
            borderWidth: 3,
            fill: true,
            tension: 0.2,
            pointRadius: 6
        });
    });
    
    if (datasets.length === 0) {
        canvasD.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    
    chartD = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: { labels, datasets },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: true, position: 'top' } },
            scales: {
                y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' } },
                x: { grid: { color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)' } }
            }
        }
    });
    
    canvasD.style.display = 'block';
}

    MODE E : LINÉAIRE
    ========================= */
function addEBlock(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiEContainer");
    const div = document.createElement("div"); div.className="ref-block";
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" class="labelE" placeholder="Nom série" oninput="autoCalculE()">
        <input type="text" class="valsE" placeholder="Valeurs (ex: 100 120 130 150)" oninput="autoCalculE()">
        <button type="button" onclick="removeNode(this)">🗑️</button>
    `;
    cont.appendChild(div);
}

function autoCalculE(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiEContainer");
    const datasets = [];
    let maxLength = 0;
    
    Array.from(cont.getElementsByClassName("ref-block")).forEach(block => {
        const raw = (block.querySelector(".valsE")?.value || "").trim();
        const vals = raw.split(/\s+/).map(parseNumber).filter(v => v !== null);
        maxLength = Math.max(maxLength, vals.length);
    });
    
    const labels = Array.from({length: maxLength}, (_, i) => `P${i + 1}`);
    const colors = ["#3498db","#2ecc71","#e74c3c","#f1c40f","#9b59b6"];
    
    Array.from(cont.getElementsByClassName("ref-block")).forEach((block, i) => {
        const label = block.querySelector(".labelE")?.value || `Série ${i + 1}`;
        const raw = (block.querySelector(".valsE")?.value || "").trim();
        const vals = raw.split(/\s+/).map(parseNumber).filter(v => v !== null);
        
        if(vals.length > 0){
            const filledVals = [...vals];
            while (filledVals.length < maxLength) filledVals.push(0);
            
            datasets.push({
                label: label,
                data: filledVals,
                fill: false,
                borderColor: colors[i % colors.length],
                borderWidth: 3,
                tension: 0.2
            });
        }
    });
    
    const canvasE = document.getElementById("graphE");
    const ctx = canvasE.getContext('2d');
    if (chartE) chartE.destroy();
    
    if (datasets.length === 0) {
        canvasE.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    
    chartE = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: { labels, datasets },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: { legend: { display: true } }
        }
    });
    
    canvasE.style.display = 'block';
}

/* =========================
    MODE F : CIRCULAIRE AVEC FUSION SIMPLIFIÉE
    ========================= */
const paletteF = ["#3498db","#2ecc71","#e74c3c","#f1c40f","#9b59b6","#1abc9c"];

function addFBlock(defaults = {}){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiFContainer");
    const div = document.createElement("div"); 
    div.className = "ref-block";
    categoryCounter++;
    const catId = defaults.id || categoryCounter;
    
    const couleurParDefaut = defaults.color || paletteF[historiqueF.length % paletteF.length];
    const labelParDefaut = defaults.label || `Catégorie ${catId}`;
    const valParDefaut = defaults.val !== undefined ? defaults.val : 100;

    div.setAttribute('data-category-id', catId);
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" class="labelF" placeholder="Catégorie" value="${labelParDefaut}" style="width:130px;" oninput="autoCalculF()">
        <input type="number" class="valF" placeholder="Valeur" value="${valParDefaut}" style="width:100px;" oninput="autoCalculF()">
        <input type="color" class="colorF" value="${couleurParDefaut}" oninput="autoCalculF()">
        <input type="checkbox" class="select-for-fusion" title="Sélectionner pour fusion">
        <button type="button" onclick="removeF(this)">🗑️</button>
    `;

    cont.appendChild(div);

    const newCat = { 
        id: catId,
        element: div, 
        label: labelParDefaut, 
        val: parseNumber(valParDefaut) || 0, 
        color: couleurParDefaut
    };
    historiqueF.push(newCat);
    
    div.querySelector(".valF").addEventListener("input", function() {
        newCat.val = parseNumber(this.value) || 0;
        autoCalculF();
    });
    
    div.querySelector(".labelF").addEventListener("input", function() {
        newCat.label = this.value;
        autoCalculF();
    });
    
    div.querySelector(".colorF").addEventListener("input", function() {
        newCat.color = this.value;
        autoCalculF();
    });

    mettreAJourTableauF();
    calculerF();
}

function removeF(btn){
    const block = btn.parentNode;
    const idx = historiqueF.findIndex(c => c.element === block);
    if(idx !== -1) historiqueF.splice(idx,1);
    block.remove();
    mettreAJourTableauF();
    calculerF();
}

function autoCalculF(){
    mettreAJourTableauF();
    calculerF();
}

function calculerF(){
    const canvasF = document.getElementById("graphF");
    const ctx = canvasF.getContext('2d');
    
    if (chartF) chartF.destroy();
    
    const validCategories = historiqueF.filter(cat => cat.label && cat.val > 0);
    
    if (validCategories.length === 0) {
        canvasF.style.display = 'none';
        return;
    }
    
    const labels = validCategories.map(cat => cat.label);
    const data = validCategories.map(cat => cat.val);
    const colors = validCategories.map(cat => cat.color);
    
    chartF = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'pie',
        data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: [{
                data: data,
                backgroundColor: colors,
                borderWidth: 2
            }]
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: { display: true, position: 'right' },
                tooltip: {
                    callbacks: {
                        label: function(context) {
                            const total = data.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
                            const percentage = ((context.parsed / total) * 100).toFixed(1);
                            return `${context.label}: ${context.parsed} € (${percentage}%)`;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
    
    canvasF.style.display = 'block';
}

function mettreAJourTableauF(){
    const tbody = document.querySelector("#tableauF tbody");
    tbody.innerHTML = "";
    
    const total = historiqueF.reduce((sum, cat) => sum + (cat.val || 0), 0);
    
    historiqueF.forEach(cat => {
        const pourcent = total > 0 ? ((cat.val / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
        const tr = document.createElement("tr");
        tr.innerHTML = `<td>${cat.label}</td><td>${cat.val.toFixed(2)} €</td><td>${pourcent}%</td><td>${cat.id}</td>`;
        tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    
    if (historiqueF.length > 0) {
        const trTotal = document.createElement("tr");
        trTotal.style.fontWeight = "bold";
        trTotal.innerHTML = `<td>Total</td><td>${total.toFixed(2)} €</td><td>100%</td><td>-</td>`;
        tbody.appendChild(trTotal);
    }
}

function selectAllForFusion(select) {
    const checkboxes = document.querySelectorAll('.select-for-fusion');
    checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.checked = select);
    showNotification(select ? 'Toutes les catégories sélectionnées' : 'Toutes les catégories désélectionnées', 'info');
}

function mergeSelectedCategories() {
    const selectedCategories = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.select-for-fusion:checked'))
        .map(cb => cb.closest('.ref-block'))
        .filter(block => block)
        .map(block => {
            const catId = parseInt(block.getAttribute('data-category-id'));
            return historiqueF.find(cat => cat.id === catId);
        })
        .filter(cat => cat);
    
    if (selectedCategories.length < 2) {
        showNotification('Veuillez sélectionner au moins 2 catégories à fusionner', 'error');
        return;
    }
    
    const fusionName = document.getElementById('fusionName').value.trim();
    if (!fusionName) {
        showNotification('Veuillez donner un nom à la nouvelle catégorie', 'error');
        return;
    }
    
    // Calculer la nouvelle valeur (somme)
    const newValue = selectedCategories.reduce((sum, cat) => sum + cat.val, 0);
    
    // Calculer la nouvelle couleur (moyenne des couleurs)
    const colorSum = selectedCategories.reduce((sum, cat) => {
        const hex = cat.color.replace('#', '');
        const r = parseInt(hex.substr(0, 2), 16);
        const g = parseInt(hex.substr(2, 2), 16);
        const b = parseInt(hex.substr(4, 2), 16);
        return {
            r: sum.r + r,
            g: sum.g + g,
            b: sum.b + b
        };
    }, {r: 0, g: 0, b: 0});
    
    const avgColor = {
        r: Math.round(colorSum.r / selectedCategories.length),
        g: Math.round(colorSum.g / selectedCategories.length),
        b: Math.round(colorSum.b / selectedCategories.length)
    };
    
    const newColor = `#${avgColor.r.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${avgColor.g.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${avgColor.b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    
    // Supprimer les anciennes catégories
    selectedCategories.forEach(cat => {
        const idx = historiqueF.findIndex(c => c.id === cat.id);
        if (idx !== -1) {
            historiqueF.splice(idx, 1);
            cat.element.remove();
        }
    });
    
    // Ajouter la nouvelle catégorie fusionnée
    addFBlock({
        label: fusionName,
        val: newValue,
        color: newColor,
        isFusion: true
    });
    
    // Réinitialiser le champ de nom
    document.getElementById('fusionName').value = '';
    
    // Désélectionner toutes les cases
    selectAllForFusion(false);
    
    showNotification(`Catégories fusionnées : ${fusionName} = ${newValue.toFixed(2)} €`, 'success');
}

function addGBlock(defaults = {}) {
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiGContainer");
    const blockId = 'gblock-' + Date.now();
    const blockName = defaults.name || 'Bloc TVA';

            <label style="color: inherit;">TVA Globale (%) : <input type="number" class="global-tva-input" value="${globalTva}" style="width:70px;" oninput="autoCalculG()"></label>
            <button type="button" onclick="addGLigneToBlock('${blockId}')" class="action-button secondary" style="padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px;">➕ Ligne</button>
            <button type="button" onclick="removeNode(this)" title="Supprimer bloc">🗑️</button>

function addGLigneToBlock(blockId, labelDefault = "", valDefault = "", typeDefault = 'HT', tvaDefault = 20) {
    const block = document.getElementById(blockId);
    if (!block) return;
    
    const container = block.querySelector('.ligneGContainer');
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'ligne-tva';
    row.style.display = 'flex';
    row.style.gap = '8px';
    row.style.alignItems = 'center';

    row.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" class="libelleG" placeholder="Libellé" value="${labelDefault}" style="flex:1;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
        <input type="number" class="valeurG" placeholder="Montant" value="${valDefault}" style="width:110px;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
        <select class="typeG" style="width:90px;" onchange="autoCalculG()">
          <option value="HT"${typeDefault==='HT' ? ' selected':''}>HT</option>
          <option value="TTC"${typeDefault==='TTC' ? ' selected':''}>TTC</option>
        </select>
        <input type="number" class="tvaIndividuelleG" placeholder="TVA (%)" value="${tvaDefault}" style="width:80px;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
        <button type="button" onclick="removeNode(this)" title="Supprimer la ligne">✖️</button>
    `;

    container.appendChild(row);
    autoCalculG();
    return row;
}

function autoCalculG(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiGContainer");
    const resDiv = document.getElementById("resultG"); 
    resDiv.innerHTML = "";

    const blocks = Array.from(cont.getElementsByClassName('g-block'));
    if (blocks.length === 0) {
        resDiv.innerHTML = "<p>Aucun bloc TVA défini.</p>";
        return;
    }

    blocks.forEach((block, idx) => {
        const blockName = block.querySelector('.bloc-nom-input')?.value || `Bloc ${idx+1}`;
        const globalTva = parseFloat(block.querySelector('.global-tva-input')?.value) || 20;
        const lines = Array.from(block.querySelectorAll('.ligne-tva'));

        let html = `<h4>${blockName} (TVA globale ${globalTva}%)</h4>`;
        html += `<table style="width:100%; margin:15px 0; border-collapse:collapse;">
            <tr>
                <th>Libellé</th><th>Montant donné</th><th>Taux TVA</th><th>Montant TVA</th><th>Montant HT</th><th>Montant TTC</th>
            </tr>`;

        let totalTVA = 0, totalHT = 0, totalTTC = 0;
        
        lines.forEach(l => {
            const lib = l.querySelector('.libelleG')?.value || '';
            const raw = parseFloat(l.querySelector('.valeurG')?.value);
            if (isNaN(raw)) return;
            
            const type = l.querySelector('.typeG')?.value || 'HT';
            const tva = parseFloat(l.querySelector('.tvaIndividuelleG')?.value);
            const applicableTva = isNaN(tva) ? globalTva : tva;

            const factor = 1 + applicableTva/100;
            let montantHT, montantTTC, tvaVal;
            
            if (type === 'HT') {
                montantHT = raw;
                montantTTC = montantHT * factor;
                tvaVal = montantTTC - montantHT;
            } else {
                montantTTC = raw;
                montantHT = montantTTC / factor;
                tvaVal = montantTTC - montantHT;
            }

            totalTVA += tvaVal;
            totalHT += montantHT;
            totalTTC += montantTTC;

            html += `<tr>
                <td style="text-align:left;">${lib}</td>
                <td>${raw.toFixed(2)} € (${type})</td>
                <td>${applicableTva}%</td>
                <td>${tvaVal.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                <td>${montantHT.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                <td>${montantTTC.toFixed(2)} €</td>
            </tr>`;
        });

        html += `<tr style="font-weight:bold; background:#2c3e50; color:white;">
            <td style="text-align:left;">Totaux</td>
            <td>—</td><td>—</td>
            <td>${totalTVA.toFixed(2)} €</td>
            <td>${totalHT.toFixed(2)} €</td>
            <td>${totalTTC.toFixed(2)} €</td>
        </tr>`;
        html += `</table>`;
        
        resDiv.innerHTML += html;
    });
}

/* =========================
    MODE H : DEVISES AVEC HISTORIQUE AMÉLIORÉ
    ========================= */
async function loadExchangeRates() {
    try {
        document.getElementById('lastUpdate').textContent = 'Chargement des taux...';
        
        const response = await axios.get('https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/latest/EUR');
        exchangeRates = response.data.rates;
        
        const defaultRates = {
            'EUR': 1, 'USD': 1.08, 'GBP': 0.86, 'CHF': 0.95, 
            'JPY': 161.5, 'CAD': 1.46, 'AUD': 1.65, 'CNY': 7.85,
            'INR': 89.2, 'RUB': 99.5, 'BRL': 5.32, 'KRW': 1440
        };
        
        exchangeRates = { ...defaultRates, ...exchangeRates };
        
        const now = new Date();
        document.getElementById('lastUpdate').textContent = 
            `Dernière actualisation: ${now.toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`;
        
        updateCurrencySelectors();
        updateRateInfo();
        convertCurrency();
        updateAllRatesDisplay();
        
        setTimeout(loadExchangeRates, 5 * 60 * 1000);
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.log('Utilisation des taux par défaut');
        document.getElementById('lastUpdate').textContent = 'Taux par défaut (hors ligne)';
        
        exchangeRates = {
            'EUR': 1, 'USD': 1.08, 'GBP': 0.86, 'CHF': 0.95, 
            'JPY': 161.5, 'CAD': 1.46, 'AUD': 1.65, 'CNY': 7.85,
            'INR': 89.2, 'RUB': 99.5, 'BRL': 5.32, 'KRW': 1440,
            'MXN': 18.2, 'SGD': 1.45, 'HKD': 8.45, 'NZD': 1.78
        };
        
        updateCurrencySelectors();
        updateRateInfo();
        convertCurrency();
        updateAllRatesDisplay();
        
        setTimeout(loadExchangeRates, 60000);
    }
}

function updateCurrencySelectors() {
    const fromSelect = document.getElementById('fromCurrency');
    const toSelect = document.getElementById('toCurrency');
    
    fromSelect.innerHTML = '';
    toSelect.innerHTML = '';
    
    const mainCurrencies = ['EUR', 'USD', 'GBP', 'CHF', 'JPY', 'CAD', 'AUD', 'CNY'];
    
    mainCurrencies.forEach(currency => {
        if (currencyNames[currency]) {
            const option1 = document.createElement('option');
            option1.value = currency;
            option1.textContent = `${currency} - ${currencyNames[currency]}`;
            fromSelect.appendChild(option1);
            
            const option2 = document.createElement('option');
            option2.value = currency;
            option2.textContent = `${currency} - ${currencyNames[currency]}`;
            toSelect.appendChild(option2);
        }
    });
    
    fromSelect.value = 'EUR';
    toSelect.value = 'USD';
    updateFlags();
}

function updateFlags() {
    const from = document.getElementById('fromCurrency').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('toCurrency').value;
    
    if (currencyFlags[from]) {
        document.getElementById('fromFlag').src = `https://flagcdn.com/w20/${currencyFlags[from]}.png`;
    }
    if (currencyFlags[to]) {
        document.getElementById('toFlag').src = `https://flagcdn.com/w20/${currencyFlags[to]}.png`;
    }
    
    updateRateInfo();
    convertCurrency();
}

function switchCurrencies() {
    const fromSelect = document.getElementById('fromCurrency');
    const toSelect = document.getElementById('toCurrency');
    const fromAmount = document.getElementById('fromAmount');
    const toAmount = document.getElementById('toAmount');
    
    // Échanger les devises
    const tempCurrency = fromSelect.value;
    fromSelect.value = toSelect.value;
    toSelect.value = tempCurrency;
    
    // Échanger les montants (en gardant la conversion)
    const tempAmount = fromAmount.value;
    fromAmount.value = toAmount.value.replace(' €', '');
    convertCurrency();
    
    updateFlags();
    showNotification('Devises inversées', 'info');
}

function updateRateInfo() {
    const from = document.getElementById('fromCurrency').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('toCurrency').value;
    
    if (exchangeRates[from] && exchangeRates[to]) {
        const rate = exchangeRates[to] / exchangeRates[from];
        const rateReverse = exchangeRates[from] / exchangeRates[to];
        
        document.getElementById('rateInfo').innerHTML = 
            `💰 Taux: 1 ${from} = <strong>${rate.toFixed(4)}</strong> ${to} | 1 ${to} = <strong>${rateReverse.toFixed(4)}</strong> ${from}`;
    }
}

function convertCurrency() {
    const from = document.getElementById('fromCurrency').value;
    const to = document.getElementById('toCurrency').value;
    const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('fromAmount').value) || 0;
    
    if (exchangeRates[from] && exchangeRates[to]) {
        const rate = exchangeRates[to] / exchangeRates[from];
        const result = amount * rate;
        
        document.getElementById('toAmount').value = result.toFixed(2) + ' €';
    }
}

function updateAllRatesDisplay() {
    const container = document.getElementById('allRatesGrid');
    if (!container) return;
    
    container.innerHTML = '';
    
    const mainCurrencies = ['USD', 'GBP', 'CHF', 'JPY', 'CAD', 'AUD', 'CNY', 'INR'];
    
    mainCurrencies.forEach(currency => {
        if (exchangeRates[currency]) {
            const rate = exchangeRates[currency];
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.style.cssText = `
                background: white;
                padding: 12px;
                border-radius: 8px;
                text-align: center;
                box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
                border: 1px solid #eee;
                transition: all 0.2s;
            `;
            div.onmouseover = () => div.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px)';
            div.onmouseout = () => div.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
            
            div.innerHTML = `
                <div style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 5px;">${currency}</div>
                <div style="color: #666; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 5px;">${currencyNames[currency] || currency}</div>
                <div style="color: #2ecc71; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold;">${rate.toFixed(4)}</div>
                <div style="font-size: 11px; color: #999;">1 EUR = ${rate.toFixed(4)} ${currency}</div>
            `;
            container.appendChild(div);
        }
    });
}

function saveConversionToHistory() {
    const fromAmount = document.getElementById('fromAmount').value;
    const fromCurrency = document.getElementById('fromCurrency').value;
    const toAmount = document.getElementById('toAmount').value;
    const toCurrency = document.getElementById('toCurrency').value;
    
    if (!fromAmount || fromAmount <= 0) {
        showNotification('Veuillez entrer un montant valide', 'error');
        return;
    }
    
    const conversion = {
        id: Date.now(),
        date: new Date().toLocaleString('fr-FR'),
        fromAmount: parseFloat(fromAmount),
        fromCurrency: fromCurrency,
        toAmount: parseFloat(toAmount.replace(' €', '')),
        toCurrency: toCurrency,
        rate: (parseFloat(toAmount.replace(' €', '')) / parseFloat(fromAmount)).toFixed(4)
    };
    
    conversionHistory.unshift(conversion);
    if (conversionHistory.length > 50) {
        conversionHistory = conversionHistory.slice(0, 50);
    }
    
    localStorage.setItem('conversionHistory', JSON.stringify(conversionHistory));
    updateConversionHistoryDisplay();
    showNotification('Conversion sauvegardée dans l\'historique !', 'success');
}

function updateConversionHistoryDisplay() {
    const container = document.getElementById('conversionHistoryList');
    if (!container) return;
    
    container.innerHTML = '';
    
    if (conversionHistory.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align: center; color: #666; padding: 20px;">Aucune conversion dans l\'historique</p>';
        return;
    }
    
    conversionHistory.forEach(conversion => {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'history-item';
        item.innerHTML = `
            <div class="history-date">${conversion.date}</div>
            <div class="history-amount">${conversion.fromAmount.toFixed(2)} ${conversion.fromCurrency}</div>
            <div class="history-result">${conversion.toAmount.toFixed(2)} ${conversion.toCurrency}</div>
            <div class="history-actions">
                <button onclick="loadConversion(${conversion.id})" style="padding: 5px 10px; background: #3498db; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">↻</button>
                <button onclick="deleteConversion(${conversion.id})" style="padding: 5px 10px; background: #e74c3c; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer;">🗑️</button>
            </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(item);
    });
}

function loadConversion(id) {
    const conversion = conversionHistory.find(c => c.id === id);
    if (conversion) {
        document.getElementById('fromAmount').value = conversion.fromAmount;
        document.getElementById('fromCurrency').value = conversion.fromCurrency;
        document.getElementById('toCurrency').value = conversion.toCurrency;
        updateFlags();
        convertCurrency();
        showNotification('Conversion chargée !', 'success');
    }
}

function deleteConversion(id) {
    conversionHistory = conversionHistory.filter(c => c.id !== id);
    localStorage.setItem('conversionHistory', JSON.stringify(conversionHistory));
    updateConversionHistoryDisplay();
    showNotification('Conversion supprimée !', 'success');
}

function clearConversionHistory() {
    if (confirm('Voulez-vous vraiment effacer tout l\'historique des conversions ?')) {
        conversionHistory = [];
        localStorage.setItem('conversionHistory', JSON.stringify(conversionHistory));
        updateConversionHistoryDisplay();
        showNotification('Historique effacé !', 'success');
    }
}

function exportHistoryToCSV() {
    if (conversionHistory.length === 0) {
        showNotification('Aucune conversion à exporter', 'warning');
        return;
    }
    
    let csv = 'Date;Devise Source;Montant Source;Devise Cible;Montant Cible;Taux\n';
    conversionHistory.forEach(conv => {
        csv += `${conv.date};${conv.fromCurrency};${conv.fromAmount.toFixed(2)};${conv.toCurrency};${conv.toAmount.toFixed(2)};${conv.rate}\n`;
    });
    
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.setAttribute('href', url);
    link.setAttribute('download', `historique_conversions_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`);
    link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    showNotification('CSV exporté avec succès', 'success');
}

async function downloadPDFReport() {
    const { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
    const doc = new jsPDF('p', 'mm', 'a4');
    const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.width;
    const pageHeight = doc.internal.pageSize.height;
    let yPos = 20;
    
    // En-tête
    doc.setFontSize(20);
    doc.setTextColor(44, 62, 80);
    doc.text('Rapport Global', pageWidth / 2, yPos, { align: 'center' });
    
    doc.setFontSize(10);
    doc.setTextColor(102, 102, 102);
    yPos += 10;
    doc.text(`Généré le ${new Date().toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`, pageWidth / 2, yPos, { align: 'center' });
    yPos += 15;
    
    // Fonction pour ajouter une page si nécessaire
    function checkPageBreak(neededSpace) {
        if (yPos + neededSpace > pageHeight - 20) {
            doc.addPage();
            yPos = 20;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    // Fonction pour ajouter une section
    function addSection(title, content, color) {
        checkPageBreak(20);
        doc.setFontSize(14);
        doc.setTextColor(color.r, color.g, color.b);
        doc.text(title, 14, yPos);
        yPos += 8;
        
        doc.setDrawColor(color.r, color.g, color.b);
        doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
        doc.line(14, yPos, pageWidth - 14, yPos);
        yPos += 10;
        
        if (content && content.trim() !== '') {
            doc.setFontSize(10);
            doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
            const lines = doc.splitTextToSize(content.substring(0, 500), pageWidth - 28);
            doc.text(lines, 14, yPos);
            yPos += (lines.length * 6) + 15;
        } else {
            doc.setFontSize(10);
            doc.setTextColor(153, 153, 153);
            doc.text('Aucune donnée', 14, yPos);
            yPos += 10;
        }
        
        // Ligne de séparation
        doc.setDrawColor(221, 221, 221);
        doc.setLineWidth(0.3);
        doc.line(14, yPos, pageWidth - 14, yPos);
        yPos += 15;
    }
    
    // Mode A
    if (document.getElementById('reportA').checked) {
        const resultA = document.getElementById('resultA').textContent || '';
        addSection('Mode A : Comparer à des valeurs', resultA, {r: 52, g: 152, b: 219});
    }
    
    // Mode B
    if (document.getElementById('reportB').checked) {
        const resultB = document.getElementById('resultB').textContent || '';
        addSection('Mode B : Gains et pertes', resultB, {r: 46, g: 204, b: 113});
    }
    
    // Mode C
    if (document.getElementById('reportC').checked) {
        const resultC = document.getElementById('resultC').textContent || '';
        addSection('Mode C : Pourcentage par bloc', resultC, {r: 231, g: 76, b: 60});
    }
    
    // Mode G
    if (document.getElementById('reportG').checked) {
        const resultG = document.getElementById('resultG').textContent || '';
        addSection('Mode G : Calculateur TVA', resultG, {r: 230, g: 126, b: 34});
    }
    
    // Mode H
    if (document.getElementById('reportH').checked) {
        checkPageBreak(20);
        doc.setFontSize(14);
        doc.setTextColor(52, 73, 94);
        doc.text('Mode H : Convertisseur de Devises', 14, yPos);
        yPos += 15;
        
        // Dernière conversion
        const fromAmount = document.getElementById('fromAmount').value;
        const fromCurrency = document.getElementById('fromCurrency').value;
        const toAmount = document.getElementById('toAmount').value;
        const toCurrency = document.getElementById('toCurrency').value;
        
        if (fromAmount && toAmount) {
            doc.setFontSize(10);
            doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
            doc.text(`Dernière conversion: ${fromAmount} ${fromCurrency} = ${toAmount} ${toCurrency}`, 14, yPos);
            yPos += 10;
        }
        
        // Historique récent
        if (conversionHistory.length > 0) {
            doc.setFontSize(10);
            doc.setTextColor(0, 0, 0);
            doc.text('Historique récent:', 14, yPos);
            yPos += 7;
            
            conversionHistory.slice(0, 3).forEach(conv => {
                doc.setFontSize(9);
                doc.text(`• ${conv.date}: ${conv.fromAmount} ${conv.fromCurrency} → ${conv.toAmount.toFixed(2)} ${conv.toCurrency}`, 20, yPos);
                yPos += 6;
            });
            yPos += 10;
        }
    }
    
    // Pied de page
    doc.setFontSize(8);
    doc.setTextColor(153, 153, 153);
    doc.text('Calculateur Global - Rapport généré automatiquement', pageWidth / 2, pageHeight - 10, { align: 'center' });
    
    // Téléchargement
    doc.save(`rapport-global-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.pdf`);
    showNotification('Rapport PDF téléchargé avec succès !', 'success');
}

/* =========================
    ASSISTANT VOCAL SIMPLIFIÉ (Navigation uniquement)
    ========================= */
function toggleVoiceAssistant() {
    if (!('webkitSpeechRecognition' in window) && !('SpeechRecognition' in window)) {
        alert('La reconnaissance vocale n\'est pas supportée par votre navigateur. Essayez Chrome ou Edge.');
        return;
    }
    
    if (!isListening) {
        startVoiceRecognition();
    } else {
        stopVoiceRecognition();
    }
}

function startVoiceRecognition() {
    const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    voiceRecognition = new SpeechRecognition();
    voiceRecognition.continuous = true;
    voiceRecognition.interimResults = true;
    voiceRecognition.lang = 'fr-FR';
    
    voiceRecognition.onstart = function() {
        isListening = true;
        document.getElementById('voiceStatus').classList.add('recording');
        document.getElementById('voiceText').textContent = 'Écoute en cours...';
        document.getElementById('voiceStatus').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('voiceIcon').textContent = '🔴';
        showVoiceFeedback('Assistant vocal activé', 'Dites "mode A" ou "rapport"');
    };
    
    voiceRecognition.onresult = function(event) {
        let interimTranscript = '';
        let finalTranscript = '';
        
        for (let i = event.resultIndex; i < event.results.length; i++) {
            const transcript = event.results[i][0].transcript;
            if (event.results[i].isFinal) {
                finalTranscript += transcript;
            } else {
                interimTranscript += transcript;
            }
        }
        
        if (finalTranscript) {
            processVoiceCommand(finalTranscript);
        }
        
        document.getElementById('voiceText').textContent = interimTranscript || finalTranscript || 'Écoute en cours...';
    };
    
    voiceRecognition.onerror = function(event) {
        console.error('Erreur de reconnaissance vocale:', event.error);
    };
    
    voiceRecognition.onend = function() {
        if (isListening) {
            // Redémarrer l'écoute
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (isListening && voiceRecognition) {
                    voiceRecognition.start();
                }
            }, 100);
        } else {
            document.getElementById('voiceStatus').classList.remove('recording');
            document.getElementById('voiceText').textContent = 'Assistant vocal prêt';
            document.getElementById('voiceIcon').textContent = '🎤';
        }
    };
    
    voiceRecognition.start();
}

function stopVoiceRecognition() {
    isListening = false;
    if (voiceRecognition) {
        voiceRecognition.stop();
    }
    document.getElementById('voiceStatus').classList.remove('recording');
    document.getElementById('voiceText').textContent = 'Assistant vocal prêt';
    document.getElementById('voiceIcon').textContent = '🎤';
    showVoiceFeedback('Assistant vocal désactivé', '');
}

function processVoiceCommand(command) {
    command = command.toLowerCase().trim();
    console.log('Commande vocale:', command);
    
    // Navigation simple entre modes
    if (command.includes('mode a') || command.includes('comparer') || command.includes('référence')) {
        showMode('modeA');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '📊 Mode A ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('mode b') || command.includes('gains') || command.includes('pertes')) {
        showMode('modeB');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '📈 Mode B ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('mode c') || command.includes('pourcentage')) {
        showMode('modeC');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '🎚️ Mode C ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('mode d') || command.includes('évolution') || command.includes('temporel')) {
        showMode('modeD');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '📈 Mode D ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('mode e') || command.includes('linéaire') || command.includes('séries')) {
        showMode('modeE');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '📈 Mode E ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('mode f') || command.includes('circulaire') || command.includes('camembert')) {
        showMode('modeF');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '🟣 Mode F ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('mode g') || command.includes('tva') || command.includes('facture')) {
        showMode('modeG');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '💰 Mode G ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('mode h') || command.includes('devises') || command.includes('conversion')) {
        showMode('modeH');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '💱 Mode H ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('rapport') || command.includes('pdf') || command.includes('rapport global')) {
        showMode('mode_rapport_global');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '📄 Rapport ouvert');
        return;
    } 
    else if (command.includes('menu') || command.includes('accueil') || command.includes('retour')) {
        showMode('none');
        showVoiceFeedback(command, '🏠 Menu principal');
        return;
    }
    
    // Si on ne comprend pas, donner une indication simple
    showVoiceFeedback(command, 'Dites "mode A" ou "rapport" pour naviguer');
}

function showVoiceFeedback(command, action) {
    const display = document.getElementById('voiceCommandDisplay');
    const commandText = document.getElementById('voiceCommandText');
    const actionText = document.getElementById('voiceCommandAction');
    
    commandText.textContent = `🗣️ "${command}"`;
    actionText.textContent = action;
    
    display.classList.add('active');
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        display.classList.remove('active');
    }, 2000);
}

    INITIALISATION

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    
    // Mode sombre
    if (localStorage.getItem('darkMode') === 'true') {
        document.body.classList.add('dark-mode');
        document.getElementById('darkModeToggle').textContent = '☀️';
    }
    
    // Charger les données sauvegardées
    try {
        const savedData = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('globalCalculatorData') || '{}');
        
        // Mode A
        if (savedData.A) {
            const containerA = document.getElementById('multiAContainer');
            containerA.innerHTML = '';
            savedData.A.forEach(block => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'ref-block';
                div.innerHTML = `
                    <input type="number" class="refA" placeholder="Réf. (€)" style="width:110px;" value="${block.ref}" oninput="autoCalculA()">
                    <input type="text" class="valsA" placeholder="Valeurs à comparer" value="${block.vals}" oninput="autoCalculA()">
                    <button type="button" onclick="removeNode(this)">🗑️</button>
                `;
                containerA.appendChild(div);
            });
        }
        
        // Mode F
        if (savedData.F) {
            historiqueF = [];
            const containerF = document.getElementById('multiFContainer');
            containerF.innerHTML = '';
            savedData.F.forEach(cat => {
                addFBlock(cat);
            });
        }
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.log("Aucune donnée à charger");
    }
    
    // Initialiser le Mode D
    addDDate('2025-01-01');
    addDDate('2025-04-01');
    addDDate('2025-07-01');
    addDSeries();
    addDSeries();
    
    dSeries[0].values[dDates[0].id] = 100;
    dSeries[0].values[dDates[1].id] = 110;
    dSeries[0].values[dDates[2].id] = 120;
    dSeries[1].values[dDates[0].id] = 80;
    dSeries[1].values[dDates[1].id] = 100;
    dSeries[1].values[dDates[2].id] = 130;
    
    updateDTable();
    
    // Initialiser le Mode H
    loadExchangeRates();
    updateConversionHistoryDisplay();
    
    // Calculer tous les modes
    autoCalculA();
    autoCalculB();
    autoCalculC();
    calculerD();
    autoCalculE();
    calculerF();
    autoCalculG();
    
    // Raccourcis clavier
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.altKey && !e.ctrlKey && !e.shiftKey) {
            switch(e.key.toUpperCase()) {
                case 'M': showMode('none'); break;
                case 'A': showMode('modeA'); break;
                case 'B': showMode('modeB'); break;
                case 'C': showMode('modeC'); break;
                case 'D': showMode('modeD'); break;
                case 'E': showMode('modeE'); break;
                case 'F': showMode('modeF'); break;
                case 'G': showMode('modeG'); break;
                case 'H': showMode('modeH'); break;
                case 'R': showMode('mode_rapport_global'); break;
                case 'V': toggleVoiceAssistant(); break;
                case 'D': if (e.altKey && !e.shiftKey) toggleDarkMode(); break;
            }
        }
    });
    
    // Sauvegarde automatique
    setInterval(autoSaveAll, 10000);
    
    console.log('✅ Calculateur Global - Assistant vocal de navigation activé !');
});

// Mode C

// =============================================
// FONCTIONS UTILITAIRES
// =============================================
function showMode(id){
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
    if (id !== 'none') {
        document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('hidden');
        
        if (id === 'modeC' && cBlocks.length === 0) addCBlock();
        if (id === 'modeH') loadExchangeRates();
        if (id === 'modeF') autoCalculF(); // Mettre à jour le graphique circulaire
    }
}

function removeNode(btn){ 
    btn.parentNode.remove();
    if (btn.closest('#multiFContainer')) autoCalculF();
    if (btn.closest('#multiGContainer')) autoCalculG();
    if (btn.closest('#multiCContainer')) updateCResults();
}

function parseNumber(value) {
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
        value = value.replace(',', '.');
    }
    const num = parseFloat(value);
    return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
}

function showNotification(message, type = 'success') {
    const colors = {
        success: '#2ecc71',
        error: '#e74c3c',
        warning: '#f1c40f',
        info: '#3498db'
    };
    
    const notification = document.createElement('div');
    notification.className = 'notification';
    notification.style.background = colors[type] || colors.info;
    notification.textContent = message;
    document.body.appendChild(notification);
    
    setTimeout(() => notification.remove(), 3000);
}

// =============================================
// MODE A
// =============================================
function addABlock(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiAContainer");
    const div = document.createElement("div"); 
    div.className = "ref-block";
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="number" class="refA" placeholder="Référence" value="100" style="width:100px;" oninput="autoCalculA()">
        <input type="text" class="valsA" placeholder="Valeurs (séparées par espaces)" value="80 120 100" style="flex:1;" oninput="autoCalculA()">
        <button onclick="removeNode(this)" class="delete-btn">🗑️</button>
    `;
    cont.appendChild(div);
}

function autoCalculA(){
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiAContainer");
    const resDiv = document.getElementById("resultA"); 
    resDiv.innerHTML = "";
    
    Array.from(cont.getElementsByClassName("ref-block")).forEach((block, index) => {
        const ref = parseNumber(block.querySelector(".refA").value);
        const raw = (block.querySelector(".valsA").value || "").trim();
        if(raw === "") return;
        const vals = raw.split(/\s+/).map(parseNumber).filter(v => v !== null); 
        
        let html = `<div style="margin:15px 0;"><h4>Bloc ${index + 1} - Référence : ${ref.toFixed(2)}€</h4>`;
        html += `<table style="width:100%;"><tr><th>Valeur</th><th>Différence</th><th>%</th></tr>`;
        
        vals.forEach(v => {
            const diff = v - ref;
            const pct = (ref === 0) ? null : (diff / ref * 100);
            const col = diff > 0 ? "#2ecc71" : diff < 0 ? "#e74c3c" : "#95a5a6";
            html += `<tr style="background:${col}; color:#fff;">
                <td>${v.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                <td>${diff>=0?'+':''}${diff.toFixed(2)} €</td>
                <td>${pct===null?'—':pct.toFixed(2)+'%'}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
        html += "</table></div>";
        resDiv.innerHTML += html;
    });
}

// =============================================
// MODE C COMPACT
// =============================================
function addCBlock() {
    const blockId = Date.now();
    const block = {
        id: blockId,
        name: `Bloc ${cBlockCounter}`,
        blockPercent: 0,
        variables: [
            { id: Date.now() + 1, name: `Variable 1`, value: 100, percent: 0 },
            { id: Date.now() + 2, name: `Variable 2`, value: 200, percent: 0 }
        ]
    };
    
    cBlocks.push(block);
    cBlockCounter++;
    renderCBlocks();
    updateCResults();
}

function renderCBlocks() {
    const container = document.getElementById('multiCContainer');
    if (cBlocks.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center; color:#666;">Ajoutez un premier bloc</p>';
        return;
    }
    
    let html = '';
    
    cBlocks.forEach((block) => {
        html += `
            <div class="c-block" data-block-id="${block.id}">
                <div class="c-block-header">
                    <input type="text" value="${block.name}" onchange="updateCBlockName(${block.id}, this.value)" 
                           style="flex:1; min-width: 150px;" placeholder="Nom du bloc">
                    <span style="font-weight:bold;">% bloc:</span>
                    <input type="range" class="c-block-slider" min="-100" max="100" value="${block.blockPercent}" 
                           oninput="updateBlockPercent(${block.id}, this.value)" style="flex: 2;">
                    <span style="width:50px; text-align:center; font-weight:bold; color:#3498db;">${block.blockPercent}%</span>
                    <button onclick="removeCBlock(${block.id})" class="delete-btn">🗑️</button>
                </div>
                
                ${block.variables.map(variable => `
                    <div class="c-variable-item">
                        <input type="number" value="${variable.value}" style="width:100px;"
                               onchange="updateVariableValue(${block.id}, ${variable.id}, this.value)">
                        <span style="width:120px; text-align:left;">${variable.name}</span>
                        <input type="range" class="c-var-slider" min="-100" max="100" value="${variable.percent}"
                               oninput="updateVariablePercent(${block.id}, ${variable.id}, this.value)" style="flex: 2;">
                        <span class="c-var-value" style="color:${variable.percent >= 0 ? '#27ae60' : '#e74c3c'}">
                            ${variable.percent >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${variable.percent}%
                        </span>
                        <button onclick="removeVariable(${block.id}, ${variable.id})" class="delete-btn" style="padding: 5px 10px;">✖</button>
                    </div>
                `).join('')}
                
                <button onclick="addVariableToBlock(${block.id})" class="secondary" style="width:100%; margin-top:10px;">
                    ➕ Ajouter une variable
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
    });
    
    container.innerHTML = html;
}

function updateCBlockName(blockId, newName) {
    const block = cBlocks.find(b => b.id === blockId);
    if (block) block.name = newName;
}

function updateBlockPercent(blockId, newPercent) {
    const block = cBlocks.find(b => b.id === blockId);
    if (block) {
        let percent = parseInt(newPercent) || 0;
        if (percent > 100) percent = 100;
        if (percent < -100) percent = -100;
        
        block.blockPercent = percent;
        block.variables.forEach(variable => {
            variable.percent = percent;
        });
        renderCBlocks();
        updateCResults();
    }
}

function updateVariableValue(blockId, variableId, newValue) {
    const block = cBlocks.find(b => b.id === blockId);
    if (block) {
        const variable = block.variables.find(v => v.id === variableId);
        if (variable) {
            variable.value = parseFloat(newValue) || 0;
            updateCResults();
        }
    }
}

function updateVariablePercent(blockId, variableId, newPercent) {
    const block = cBlocks.find(b => b.id === blockId);
    if (block) {
        const variable = block.variables.find(v => v.id === variableId);
        if (variable) {
            let percent = parseInt(newPercent) || 0;
            if (percent > 100) percent = 100;
            if (percent < -100) percent = -100;
            
            variable.percent = percent;
            renderCBlocks();
            updateCResults();
        }
    }
}

function addVariableToBlock(blockId) {
    const block = cBlocks.find(b => b.id === blockId);
    if (block) {
        block.variables.push({
            id: Date.now(),
            name: `Variable ${block.variables.length + 1}`,
            value: 100,
            percent: block.blockPercent
        });
        renderCBlocks();
        updateCResults();
    }
}

function removeVariable(blockId, variableId) {
    const block = cBlocks.find(b => b.id === blockId);
    if (block && block.variables.length > 1) {
        block.variables = block.variables.filter(v => v.id !== variableId);
        renderCBlocks();
        updateCResults();
    } else {
        showNotification('Un bloc doit avoir au moins une variable', 'warning');
    }
}

function removeCBlock(blockId) {
    if (cBlocks.length <= 1) {
        showNotification('Vous devez garder au moins un bloc', 'warning');
        return;
    }
    
    if (confirm('Voulez-vous vraiment supprimer ce bloc ?')) {
        cBlocks = cBlocks.filter(b => b.id !== blockId);
        renderCBlocks();
        updateCResults();
        showNotification('Bloc supprimé avec succès', 'success');
    }
}

function updateCResults() {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('cResultsBody');
    const tfoot = document.getElementById('cResultsTotal');
    let html = '';
    
    let totalInitial = 0;
    let totalFinal = 0;
    let totalVariation = 0;
    
    cBlocks.forEach(block => {
        block.variables.forEach(variable => {
            const initial = variable.value;
            const final = initial * (1 + variable.percent / 100);
            const variation = final - initial;
            
            totalInitial += initial;
            totalFinal += final;
            totalVariation += variation;
            
            html += `<tr>
                <td>${block.name}</td>
                <td>${variable.name}</td>
                <td>${initial.toFixed(2)}</td>
                <td>${variable.percent >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${variable.percent}%</td>
                <td>${final.toFixed(2)}</td>
                <td class="${variation >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'}">${variation >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${variation.toFixed(2)}</td>
            </tr>`;
        });
    });
    
    tbody.innerHTML = html;
    
    // Ajouter la ligne de total
    tfoot.innerHTML = `
        <tr class="total-row">
            <td colspan="2"><strong>TOTAL GLOBAL</strong></td>
            <td><strong>${totalInitial.toFixed(2)}</strong></td>
            <td></td>
            <td><strong>${totalFinal.toFixed(2)}</strong></td>
            <td class="${totalVariation >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'}">
                <strong>${totalVariation >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${totalVariation.toFixed(2)}</strong>
            </td>
        </tr>
    `;
}

// =============================================
// MODE D CORRIGE
// =============================================
function addDDate() {
    const date = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
    const id = Date.now();
    dDates.push({ id, date });
    updateDTable();
}

function removeDDate(id) {
    dDates = dDates.filter(d => d.id !== id);
    dSeries.forEach(s => {
        delete s.values[id];
    });
    updateDTable();
}

function addDSeries() {
    const newSeries = {
        id: Date.now(),
        name: `Série ${dSeries.length + 1}`,
        values: {},
        color: '#' + Math.floor(Math.random()*16777215).toString(16)
    };
    dDates.forEach(d => {
        newSeries.values[d.id] = 0;
    });
    dSeries.push(newSeries);
    updateDTable();
}

function removeDSeries(id) {
    dSeries = dSeries.filter(s => s.id !== id);
    updateDTable();
}

function updateDDate(id, newDate) {
    const dateObj = dDates.find(d => d.id === id);
    if (dateObj) {
        dateObj.date = newDate;
    }
}

function updateDSeriesName(id, newName) {
    const series = dSeries.find(s => s.id === id);
    if (series) {
        series.name = newName;
    }
}

function updateDSeriesColor(id, newColor) {
    const series = dSeries.find(s => s.id === id);
    if (series) {
        series.color = newColor;
    }
}

function updateDSeriesValue(seriesId, dateId, newValue) {
    const series = dSeries.find(s => s.id === seriesId);
    if (series) {
        series.values[dateId] = parseFloat(newValue) || 0;
    }
}

function updateDTable() {
    const dateHeader = document.getElementById('dateHeaderRow');
    const seriesBody = document.getElementById('seriesBody');
    
    // Mettre à jour l'en-tête des dates
    let headerHTML = '<th style="min-width: 160px;">Série / Date</th>';
    dDates.forEach(d => {
        headerHTML += `
            <th>
                <input type="date" value="${d.date}" onchange="updateDDate(${d.id}, this.value)" style="width:120px;">
                <button onclick="removeDDate(${d.id})" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:11px; background: #e74c3c; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer;">✖</button>
            </th>
        `;
    });
    dateHeader.innerHTML = headerHTML;
    
    // Mettre à jour le corps du tableau
    seriesBody.innerHTML = '';
    dSeries.forEach(s => {
        let row = document.createElement('tr');
        let rowHTML = `
            <td>
                <input type="text" value="${s.name}" onchange="updateDSeriesName(${s.id}, this.value)" style="width:120px;">
                <input type="color" value="${s.color}" onchange="updateDSeriesColor(${s.id}, this.value)" title="Couleur" style="width: 30px; height: 30px;">
                <button onclick="removeDSeries(${s.id})" style="padding:2px 6px;font-size:11px; background: #e74c3c; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer;">✖</button>
            </td>
        `;
        
        dDates.forEach(d => {
            const val = s.values[d.id] || 0;
            rowHTML += `
                <td>
                    <input type="number" value="${val}" 
                           onchange="updateDSeriesValue(${s.id}, ${d.id}, this.value)" 
                           style="width:80px;" step="0.01">
                </td>
            `;
        });
        
        row.innerHTML = rowHTML;
        seriesBody.appendChild(row);
    });
}

function sortDDates() {
    dDates.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.date) - new Date(b.date));
    updateDTable();
}

function calculerD() {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('graphD')?.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    
    if (chartD) {
        chartD.destroy();
    }
    
    const labels = dDates.map(d => d.date);
    const datasets = dSeries.map(s => ({
        label: s.name,
        data: dDates.map(d => s.values[d.id] || 0),
        borderColor: s.color,
        backgroundColor: s.color + '20',
        fill: false,
        tension: 0.1
    }));
    
    chartD = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: datasets
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    position: 'top',
                },
                title: {
                    display: true,
                    text: 'Évolution temporelle'
                }
            },
            scales: {
                y: {
                    beginAtZero: true,
                    grid: {
                        color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'
                    }
                },
                x: {
                    grid: {
                        color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

// =============================================
// MODE E
// =============================================
function addEBlock() {
    const cont = document.getElementById("multiEContainer");
    const div = document.createElement("div"); 
    div.className = "ref-block";
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" class="labelE" placeholder="Nom de la série" oninput="autoCalculE()" style="width:150px;">
        <input type="text" class="valsE" placeholder="Valeurs (séparées par espaces)" oninput="autoCalculE()" style="flex:1;">
        <button onclick="removeNode(this)" class="delete-btn">🗑️</button>
    `;
    cont.appendChild(div);
}

function autoCalculE() { 
    calculerE(); 
}

function calculerE() {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('graphE')?.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    
    if (chartE) {
        chartE.destroy();
    }
    
    const blocks = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#multiEContainer .ref-block'));
    const seriesData = [];
    
    blocks.forEach(block => {
        const label = block.querySelector('.labelE').value || 'Série sans nom';
        const raw = (block.querySelector('.valsE').value || "").trim();
        if (raw === "") return;
        
        const values = raw.split(/\s+/).map(parseNumber).filter(v => v !== null);
        if (values.length > 0) {
            seriesData.push({
                label: label,
                data: values,
                borderColor: '#' + Math.floor(Math.random()*16777215).toString(16),
                backgroundColor: '#3498db20',
                fill: false,
                tension: 0.1
            });
        }
    });
    
    if (seriesData.length === 0) return;
    
    const maxLength = Math.max(...seriesData.map(s => s.data.length));
    const labels = Array.from({length: maxLength}, (_, i) => `Point ${i + 1}`);
    
    chartE = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'line',
        data: {
            labels: labels,
            datasets: seriesData
        },
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    position: 'top',
                },
                title: {
                    display: true,
                    text: 'Graphique linéaire multi-séries'
                }
            },
            scales: {
                y: {
                    beginAtZero: true,
                    grid: {
                        color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'
                    }
                },
                x: {
                    grid: {
                        color: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

// =============================================
// MODE F AMELIORE
// =============================================
function addFBlock() {
    const container = document.getElementById("multiFContainer");
    const id = historiqueF.length + 1;
    
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "ref-block";
    div.setAttribute('data-category-id', id);
    div.innerHTML = `
        <input type="text" class="labelF" placeholder="Catégorie" value="Catégorie ${id}" style="width:150px;" oninput="autoCalculF()">
        <input type="number" class="valF" placeholder="Valeur" value="100" style="width:100px;" oninput="autoCalculF()">
        <input type="color" class="colorF" value="#${Math.floor(Math.random()*16777215).toString(16)}" oninput="autoCalculF()">
        <div class="fusion-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleFusionSelection(this)" data-selected="false">✗</div>
        <button onclick="removeF(this)" class="delete-btn">🗑️</button>
    `;
    
    container.appendChild(div);
    autoCalculF();
    updateSelectedCount();
}

function removeF(btn) {
    const block = btn.closest('.ref-block');
    block.remove();
    autoCalculF();
    updateSelectedCount();
}

function autoCalculF() { 
    calculerF(); 
}

function calculerF() {
    const ctx = document.getElementById('graphF')?.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;
    
    if (chartF) {
        chartF.destroy();
    }
    
    // Mettre à jour historiqueF avec les valeurs actuelles
    historiqueF = [];
    const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('#multiFContainer .ref-block');
    blocks.forEach(block => {
        historiqueF.push({
            label: block.querySelector('.labelF').value,
            val: parseFloat(block.querySelector('.valF').value) || 0,
            color: block.querySelector('.colorF').value
        });
    });
    
    if (historiqueF.length === 0) return;
    
    const total = historiqueF.reduce((sum, cat) => sum + cat.val, 0);
    
    const data = {
        labels: historiqueF.map(cat => cat.label),
        datasets: [{
            data: historiqueF.map(cat => cat.val),
            backgroundColor: historiqueF.map(cat => cat.color),
            borderWidth: 2,
            borderColor: '#ffffff'
        }]
    };
    
    chartF = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: 'pie',
        data: data,
        options: {
            responsive: true,
            maintainAspectRatio: false,
            plugins: {
                legend: {
                    position: 'right',
                },
                title: {
                    display: true,
                    text: `Répartition - Total: ${total.toFixed(2)}`
                },
                datalabels: {
                    formatter: (value, ctx) => {
                        if (total === 0) return '0%';
                        const percentage = (value / total * 100).toFixed(1);
                        return `${percentage}%`;
                    },
                    color: '#fff',
                    font: {
                        weight: 'bold',
                        size: 12
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        plugins: [ChartDataLabels]
    });
    
    // Mettre à jour le tableau
    const tbody = document.querySelector('#tableauF tbody');
    const tfoot = document.getElementById('tableauFTotal');
    
    tbody.innerHTML = '';
    historiqueF.forEach((cat, index) => {
        const percentage = total === 0 ? 0 : (cat.val / total * 100);
        tbody.innerHTML += `<tr>
            <td><span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:${cat.color};margin-right:8px;border-radius:2px;"></span>${cat.label}</td>
            <td>${cat.val.toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>${percentage.toFixed(1)}%</td>
        </tr>`;
    });
    
    // Ajouter le total
    tfoot.innerHTML = `
        <tr style="font-weight: bold; background: #e8f2fc;">
            <td>TOTAL</td>
            <td>${total.toFixed(2)}</td>
            <td>100%</td>
        </tr>
    `;
}

function toggleFusionSelection(btn) {
    const isSelected = btn.getAttribute('data-selected') === 'true';
    if (isSelected) {
        btn.textContent = '✗';
        btn.classList.remove('selected');
        btn.setAttribute('data-selected', 'false');
    } else {
        btn.textContent = '✓';
        btn.classList.add('selected');
        btn.setAttribute('data-selected', 'true');
    }
    updateSelectedCount();
}

function updateSelectedCount() {
    const selected = document.querySelectorAll('.fusion-toggle-btn[data-selected="true"]');
    document.getElementById('selectedCount').textContent = selected.length;
}

function selectAllForFusion(select) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.fusion-toggle-btn').forEach(btn => {
        if (select) {
            btn.textContent = '✓';
            btn.classList.add('selected');
            btn.setAttribute('data-selected', 'true');
        } else {
            btn.textContent = '✗';
            btn.classList.remove('selected');
            btn.setAttribute('data-selected', 'false');
        }
    });
    updateSelectedCount();
}

function mergeSelectedCategories() {
    const selected = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.fusion-toggle-btn[data-selected="true"]'));
    if (selected.length < 2) {
        showNotification('Sélectionnez au moins 2 catégories à fusionner.', 'warning');
        return;
    }
    
    const fusionName = document.getElementById('fusionName').value || 'Fusionnée';
    let totalVal = 0;
    let color = '#3498db';
    
    // Calculer la somme et prendre la couleur de la première catégorie
    selected.forEach((btn, index) => {
        const block = btn.closest('.ref-block');
        const val = parseFloat(block.querySelector('.valF').value) || 0;
        totalVal += val;
        if (index === 0) {
            color = block.querySelector('.colorF').value;
        }
        block.remove();
    });
    
    // Ajouter la nouvelle catégorie fusionnée
    addFBlock();
    const lastBlock = document.querySelector('#multiFContainer .ref-block:last-child');
    lastBlock.querySelector('.labelF').value = fusionName;
    lastBlock.querySelector('.valF').value = totalVal;
    lastBlock.querySelector('.colorF').value = color;
    
    // Réinitialiser le champ de nom
    document.getElementById('fusionName').value = '';
    
    showNotification(`Catégories fusionnées en "${fusionName}"`, 'success');
}

// MODE G
// =============================================
function addGBlock() {
    const container = document.getElementById("multiGContainer");
    const blockId = 'gblock-' + Date.now();
    
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.className = "ref-block";
    div.id = blockId;
    div.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%;">
            <input type="text" class="bloc-nom-input" value="Nouveau bloc" placeholder="Nom du bloc" style="flex:1;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
            <label>TVA Globale (%): <input type="number" class="global-tva-input" value="20" style="width:70px;" oninput="autoCalculG()"></label>
            <button onclick="addGLigneToBlock('${blockId}')" class="secondary">➕ Ligne</button>
            <button onclick="removeNode(this)" class="delete-btn">🗑️</button>
        </div>
        <div class="ligneGContainer" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:15px;">
            <div class="ligne-tva" style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;">
                <input type="text" class="libelleG" placeholder="Libellé" value="Produit" style="flex:1;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
                <input type="number" class="valeurG" placeholder="Montant" value="100" style="width:110px;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
                <select class="typeG" style="width:90px;" onchange="autoCalculG()">
                    <option value="HT">HT</option>
                    <option value="TTC" selected>TTC</option>
                </select>
                <input type="number" class="tvaIndividuelleG" placeholder="TVA (%)" value="20" style="width:80px;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
                <button onclick="removeNode(this)" class="delete-btn">✖</button>
