function loadSettings() {
    const defaultSettings = {
        autoSave: true,
        notifications: true,
        confirmations: true,
        decimalPlaces: 2,
        defaultCurrency: 'EUR',
        autoRound: true,
        defaultTheme: 'light'
    };
    
    const savedSettings = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SETTINGS_KEY) || '{}');
    settings = { ...defaultSettings, ...savedSettings };
    
    const autoSave = document.getElementById('autoSave');
    const notifications = document.getElementById('notifications');
    const confirmations = document.getElementById('confirmations');
    const decimalPlaces = document.getElementById('decimalPlaces');
    const defaultCurrency = document.getElementById('defaultCurrency');
    const autoRound = document.getElementById('autoRound');
    const defaultTheme = document.getElementById('defaultTheme');
    
    if (autoSave) autoSave.checked = settings.autoSave;
    if (notifications) notifications.checked = settings.notifications;
    if (confirmations) confirmations.checked = settings.confirmations;
    if (decimalPlaces) decimalPlaces.value = settings.decimalPlaces;
    if (defaultCurrency) defaultCurrency.value = settings.defaultCurrency;
    if (autoRound) autoRound.checked = settings.autoRound;
    if (defaultTheme) defaultTheme.value = settings.defaultTheme;
}

function saveSettings() {
    const autoSave = document.getElementById('autoSave');
    const notifications = document.getElementById('notifications');
    const confirmations = document.getElementById('confirmations');
    const decimalPlaces = document.getElementById('decimalPlaces');
    const defaultCurrency = document.getElementById('defaultCurrency');
    const autoRound = document.getElementById('autoRound');
    const defaultTheme = document.getElementById('defaultTheme');
    
    const newSettings = {
        autoSave: autoSave ? autoSave.checked : true,
        notifications: notifications ? notifications.checked : true,
        confirmations: confirmations ? confirmations.checked : true,
        decimalPlaces: decimalPlaces ? parseInt(decimalPlaces.value) : 2,
        defaultCurrency: defaultCurrency ? defaultCurrency.value : 'EUR',
        autoRound: autoRound ? autoRound.checked : true,
        defaultTheme: defaultTheme ? defaultTheme.value : 'light'
    };
    
    settings = newSettings;
    
    localStorage.setItem(SETTINGS_KEY, JSON.stringify(settings));
    
    showNotification('Paramètres enregistrés', 'success');
    
    // Appliquer immédiatement les paramètres qui nécessitent une action
    if (settings.defaultTheme === 'dark') {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'dark');
        currentTheme = 'dark';
    } else if (settings.defaultTheme === 'light') {
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
        currentTheme = 'light';
    } else if (settings.defaultTheme === 'auto') {
        const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
        currentTheme = prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
    }
    
    const themeIcon = document.querySelector('#themeIcon');
    if (themeIcon) {
        themeIcon.className = currentTheme === 'light' ? 'fas fa-moon' : 'fas fa-sun';
    }
}

function resetSettings() {
    if (confirmWithSetting('Réinitialiser tous les paramètres aux valeurs par défaut ?')) {
        localStorage.removeItem(SETTINGS_KEY);
        
        settings = {
            autoSave: true,
            notifications: true,
            confirmations: true,
            decimalPlaces: 2,
            defaultCurrency: 'EUR',
            autoRound: true,
            defaultTheme: 'light'
        };
        
        loadSettings();
        
        // Appliquer le thème par défaut
        document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
        currentTheme = 'light';
        const themeIcon = document.querySelector('#themeIcon');
        if (themeIcon) themeIcon.className = 'fas fa-moon';
        
        showNotification('Paramètres réinitialisés', 'success');
    }
}

function showSettings() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('settingsModal');
    if (modal) {
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
        loadSettings();
        displayShortcuts();
    }
}

function closeSettings() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('settingsModal');
    if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
}

        return true;
    }
    return confirm(message);
}

// ============================================
// GESTIONNAIRE DE RACCOURCIS CLAVIER AMÉLIORÉ
// ============================================
// ============================================
// RACCOURCIS CLAVIER — CAPTURE INTERACTIVE
// ============================================
let _shortcutCaptureHandler = null;

function startShortcutCapture(input) {
    input.value = '';
    input.placeholder = '⌨ Appuyez votre combinaison…';
    input.style.borderColor = 'var(--accent-color)';
    input.style.boxShadow = '0 0 0 3px rgba(52,152,219,0.2)';

    _shortcutCaptureHandler = function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        const combo = formatShortcut(e);
        if (combo) {
            input.value = combo;
            input.style.borderColor = 'var(--success-color)';
        }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', _shortcutCaptureHandler, true);
}

function stopShortcutCapture(input) {
    if (_shortcutCaptureHandler) {
        document.removeEventListener('keydown', _shortcutCaptureHandler, true);
        _shortcutCaptureHandler = null;
    }
    input.placeholder = 'Cliquez ici puis appuyez la combinaison…';
    input.style.boxShadow = '';
    if (!input.value) input.style.borderColor = '';
}

function initKeyboardShortcuts() {
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event) {
        // Ne pas déclencher si on est dans un champ de saisie
        if (event.target.tagName === 'INPUT' || event.target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || event.target.tagName === 'SELECT') {
            return;
        }
        
        const pressedKey = formatShortcut(event);
        
        keyboardShortcuts.forEach(shortcut => {
            if (shortcut.key === pressedKey) {
                event.preventDefault();
                showMode(shortcut.mode);
                showNotification(`Raccourci: ${shortcut.key} → ${shortcut.description}`, 'info');
            }
        });
    });
}

function formatShortcut(event) {
    const parts = [];
    if (event.ctrlKey) parts.push('Ctrl');
    if (event.altKey) parts.push('Alt');
    if (event.shiftKey) parts.push('Shift');
    if (event.metaKey) parts.push('Meta');
    
    let key = event.key;
    
    // Normaliser les touches spéciales
    if (key === ' ') key = 'Space';
    else if (key === 'Control' || key === 'Alt' || key === 'Shift' || key === 'Meta') {
        // Ignorer les touches modificatrices seules
        return '';
    } else if (key.length === 1) {
        key = key.toUpperCase();
    } else {
        key = key.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + key.slice(1);
    }
    
    parts.push(key);
    return parts.join('+');
}

function addShortcut() {
    const keyInput = document.getElementById('shortcutKey');
    const modeSelect = document.getElementById('shortcutMode');
    
    if (!keyInput || !modeSelect) return;
    
    const key = keyInput.value.trim();
    const mode = modeSelect.value;
    
    if (!key) {
        showNotification('Veuillez saisir un raccourci clavier', 'warning');
        return;
    }
    
    // Vérifier si le raccourci existe déjà
    if (keyboardShortcuts.some(s => s.key === key)) {
        showNotification('Ce raccourci est déjà utilisé', 'warning');
        return;
    }
    
    const shortcut = {
        id: Date.now(),
        key: key,
        mode: mode,
        description: `Ouvrir ${document.querySelector(`option[value="${mode}"]`)?.textContent || mode}`
    };
    
    keyboardShortcuts.push(shortcut);
    localStorage.setItem(SHORTCUTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(keyboardShortcuts));
    
    keyInput.value = '';
    displayShortcuts();
    showNotification('Raccourci ajouté', 'success');
}

function deleteShortcut(id) {
    if (confirmWithSetting('Supprimer ce raccourci ?')) {
        keyboardShortcuts = keyboardShortcuts.filter(s => s.id !== id);
        localStorage.setItem(SHORTCUTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(keyboardShortcuts));
        displayShortcuts();
        showNotification('Raccourci supprimé', 'success');
    }
}

function displayShortcuts() {
    const container = document.getElementById('shortcutsList');
    if (!container) return;
    
    if (keyboardShortcuts.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p style="color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; padding: 20px;">Aucun raccourci personnalisé</p>';
        return;
    }
    
    let html = '';
    keyboardShortcuts.forEach(shortcut => {
        html += `
            <div class="shortcut-item">
                <div>
                    <span class="shortcut-key">${shortcut.key}</span>
                    <span style="margin-left: 10px;">${shortcut.description}</span>
                    <div class="shortcut-meta">Mode: ${shortcut.mode}</div>
                </div>
                <button onclick="deleteShortcut(${shortcut.id})" class="delete-btn" style="padding: 5px 10px;">
                    <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                </button>
            </div>
        `;
    });
    
    container.innerHTML = html;
}

function saveAllData() {
    try {
        const appData = {
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            version: '16.0',
            notes: notes,
            settings: settings,
            tables: { tables, currentTableId, tableCounter, numberingType },
            conversionHistory: conversionHistory,
            recentCalculations: recentCalculations,
            calcHistory: calcHistory,
            cBlocks: cBlocks,
            cBlockCounter: cBlockCounter,
            budgetCategories: budgetCategories,
            budgetCatCount: budgetCatCount,
            dDates: dDates,
            dSeries: dSeries,
            modeASaves: modeASaves,
            modeCSaves: modeCSaves,
            modeBSaves: modeBSaves,
            modeDSaves: modeDSaves,
            modeFSaves: modeFSaves,
            modeGSaves: modeGSaves,
            modeTableSaves: modeTableSaves,
            keyboardShortcuts: keyboardShortcuts
        };
        
        localStorage.setItem(APP_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(appData));
        console.log('💾 Données principales sauvegardées');
        return appData;
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ Erreur sauvegarde:', error);
        return null;
    }
}

function loadAllData() {
    try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(APP_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
            const data = JSON.parse(saved);
            
            if (data.notes) notes = data.notes;
            if (data.settings) settings = { ...settings, ...data.settings };
            if (data.tables) {
                tables = data.tables.tables || [];
                currentTableId = data.tables.currentTableId || null;
                tableCounter = data.tables.tableCounter || 1;
                numberingType = data.tables.numberingType || 'numbers';
            }
            if (data.conversionHistory) conversionHistory = data.conversionHistory;
            if (data.recentCalculations) recentCalculations = data.recentCalculations;
            if (data.calcHistory) calcHistory = data.calcHistory;
            if (data.cBlocks) cBlocks = data.cBlocks;
            if (data.cBlockCounter) cBlockCounter = data.cBlockCounter;
            if (data.budgetCategories) budgetCategories = data.budgetCategories;
            if (data.budgetCatCount) budgetCatCount = data.budgetCatCount;
            if (data.dDates) dDates = data.dDates;
            if (data.dSeries) dSeries = data.dSeries;
            if (data.modeASaves) modeASaves = data.modeASaves;
            if (data.modeCSaves) modeCSaves = data.modeCSaves;
            if (data.modeBSaves) modeBSaves = data.modeBSaves;
            if (data.modeDSaves) modeDSaves = data.modeDSaves;
            if (data.modeFSaves) modeFSaves = data.modeFSaves;
            if (data.modeGSaves) modeGSaves = data.modeGSaves;
            if (data.modeTableSaves) modeTableSaves = data.modeTableSaves;
            if (data.keyboardShortcuts) keyboardShortcuts = data.keyboardShortcuts;
            
            console.log('✅ Données chargées');
            return true;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('❌ Erreur chargement:', error);
    }
    
    return false;
}

function initDefaultData() {
    if (cBlocks.length === 0) addCBlock();
    if (budgetCategories.length === 0) addBudgetCategory();
    if (dDates.length === 0) {

        dDates.push({ id: Date.now() + 1, date: new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString().split('T')[0] });
        dSeries.push({
            id: Date.now() + 2,
            name: "Série 1",
            values: {},
            color: "#" + Math.floor(Math.random()*16777215).toString(16)
        });
    }
    
    const fBlocks = document.querySelectorAll('#multiFContainer .ref-block');
    if (fBlocks.length === 0) {
        addFBlock();
        addFBlock();
    }
    
    if (calcHistory.length === 0) {
        calcHistory = [
            {
                id: Date.now() - 1000,
                expression: "2+2",
                result: 4,
                timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('fr-FR')
            },
            {
                id: Date.now() - 2000,
                expression: "sin(pi/2)",
                result: 1,
                timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('fr-FR')
            }
        ];
        localStorage.setItem(CALCULATOR_HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(calcHistory));
    }
}

function initModes() {

}

// THÈME

function toggleTheme() {
    currentTheme = currentTheme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', currentTheme);
    localStorage.setItem('calculator_theme', currentTheme);
    
    const themeIcon = document.querySelector('#themeIcon');
    if (themeIcon) themeIcon.className = currentTheme === 'light' ? 'fas fa-moon' : 'fas fa-sun';
    
    showNotification(`Thème ${currentTheme === 'light' ? 'clair' : 'sombre'} activé`, 'info');
}

function loadTheme() {
    const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('calculator_theme') || settings.defaultTheme || 'light';
    
    if (savedTheme === 'auto') {
        const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
        currentTheme = prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
    } else {
        currentTheme = savedTheme;
    }
    
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', currentTheme);
    
    const themeIcon = document.querySelector('#themeIcon');
    if (themeIcon) themeIcon.className = currentTheme === 'light' ? 'fas fa-moon' : 'fas fa-sun';
}

// ============================================
// FONCTION DE NOTIFICATION
// ============================================
function showNotification(message, type = 'success', duration = 4000) {
    if (!settings || !settings.notifications) return;
    
    const container = document.getElementById('notificationContainer');
    if (!container) return;
    
    const notification = document.createElement('div');
    notification.className = `notification ${type}`;
    
    const icon = type === 'success' ? 'check-circle' :
                 type === 'error' ? 'exclamation-circle' :
                 type === 'warning' ? 'exclamation-triangle' : 'info-circle';
    
    notification.innerHTML = `<i class="fas fa-${icon}"></i> ${message}`;
    
    container.appendChild(notification);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        notification.style.animation = 'slideOut 0.3s ease';
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (container.contains(notification)) {
                container.removeChild(notification);
            }
        }, 300);
    }, duration);
    
    const style = document.querySelector('#notification-animation') || document.createElement('style');
    style.id = 'notification-animation';
    style.textContent = `
        @keyframes slideOut {
            from { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
            to { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; }
        }
    `;
    if (!document.querySelector('#notification-animation')) {
        document.head.appendChild(style);
    }
}

// ============================================
// FONCTION DE FORMATAGE DES NOMBRES
// ============================================
function formatNumberWithSettings(value) {
    const decimalPlaces = (settings && settings.decimalPlaces) || 2;
    const rounded = (settings && settings.autoRound) ? parseFloat(value).toFixed(decimalPlaces) : value;
    return parseFloat(rounded);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    console.log('🚀 Calculateur Global Pro + Tableaux v16 - Calculatrice Scientifique');
    
    loadSettings();
    loadTheme();
    loadAllData();
    loadNotes();
    initModes();
    initDefaultData();
    loadExchangeRates();
    
    // Initialisation de l'historique de la calculatrice
    const savedCalcHistory = localStorage.getItem(CALCULATOR_HISTORY_KEY);
    if (savedCalcHistory) {
        try {
            calcHistory = JSON.parse(savedCalcHistory);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Erreur chargement historique calculatrice:', e);
        }
    }
    updateCalcHistoryDisplay();
    updateDashboard();
    
    loadTablesFromMemory();
    if (tables.length === 0) createDefaultTable();
    
    updateCalculations();
    
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', stopResize);
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onResize);
    document.addEventListener('drop', handleDrop);
    document.addEventListener('dragover', (e) => e.preventDefault());
    document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
        const contextMenu = document.getElementById('contextMenu');
        if (contextMenu && contextMenu.classList.contains('show') && !contextMenu.contains(event.target)) {
            contextMenu.classList.remove('show');
        }
    });
    
    // Événements pour la calculatrice
    const calcInput = document.getElementById('calc-input');
    if (calcInput) {
        calcInput.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);
        calcInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                performExecution();
            }
        });
    }
    
    enhanceNumberInputs();
    
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    if (sidebar) {
        if (sidebarCollapsed) {
            sidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
            const toggleBtn = document.querySelector('.toggle-btn i');
            if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.className = 'fas fa-chevron-right';
        }
    }
    
    loadTheme();
    
    const homeItem = document.querySelector('.menu-item[onclick*="home"]');
    if (homeItem) homeItem.classList.add('active');
    
    // Initialiser les raccourcis clavier
    initKeyboardShortcuts();
    
    // Démarrer la sauvegarde automatique
    initAutoSave();
    
    showNotification('Calculateur Global Pro + Tableaux v16 prêt !', 'success');
});

    <script>
// ============================================
// MOTEUR DE GRAPHIQUES 100% LOCAL
// Remplace Chart.js : aucune dépendance externe, aucun réseau requis.
// Utilisé par Mode D (courbes) et Mode F (camembert). Fonctionne donc
// intégralement hors ligne, où que soit ouvert le fichier dans le monde.
// ============================================
function getCssVarValue(name, fallback) {
    try {
        const v = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
        return v || fallback;
    } catch (e) { return fallback; }
}

function setupCanvasHiDPI(canvas) {
    const box = canvas.parentElement;
    const rect = box.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = Math.max(rect.width || 300, 260);
    const h = Math.max(rect.height || 340, 260);
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(w * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(h * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    return { ctx, width: w, height: h };
}

function getOrCreateLegendEl(canvas) {
    const legendHost = canvas.parentElement.parentElement || canvas.parentElement;
    let legendEl = legendHost.querySelector(':scope > .vanilla-chart-legend[data-for="' + canvas.id + '"]');
    if (!legendEl) {
        legendEl = document.createElement('div');
        legendEl.className = 'vanilla-chart-legend';
        legendEl.setAttribute('data-for', canvas.id);
        legendHost.appendChild(legendEl);
    }
    return legendEl;
}

function destroyVanillaChart(chart) {
    if (chart && typeof chart._cleanup === 'function') chart._cleanup();
}

/**
 * Graphique circulaire (camembert), 100% canvas natif.
 * cfg: { labels, values, colors, title, showValues, showPercent, hidden(labels[]), onSliceClick(label), onLegendClick(label) }
 */
function drawPieChartVanilla(canvas, cfg) {
    const { ctx, width, height } = setupCanvasHiDPI(canvas);
    const labels = cfg.labels || [];
    const values = cfg.values || [];
    const colors = cfg.colors || [];
    const hiddenSet = new Set(cfg.hidden || []);
    const total = values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    ctx.fillStyle = getCssVarValue('--text-primary', '#333');
    ctx.font = '600 14px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(cfg.title || '', width / 2, 20);

    const cx = width / 2;
    const cy = 24 + (height - 30) / 2;
    const radius = Math.max(Math.min(cx - 10, (height - 40) / 2) - 6, 35);

    const slices = [];
    if (total <= 0 || values.length === 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = getCssVarValue('--text-muted', '#999');
        ctx.font = '13px system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('Aucune donnée à afficher', cx, cy);
    } else {
        let startAngle = -Math.PI / 2;
        values.forEach((val, i) => {
            const angle = (val / total) * Math.PI * 2;
            const endAngle = startAngle + angle;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx, cy);
            ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, startAngle, endAngle);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fillStyle = colors[i] || '#3498db';
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = getCssVarValue('--bg-secondary', '#fff');
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.stroke();

            const mid = (startAngle + endAngle) / 2;
            slices.push({ label: labels[i], startAngle, endAngle });

            if (angle > 0.16) {
                const lx = cx + Math.cos(mid) * radius * 0.62;
                const ly = cy + Math.sin(mid) * radius * 0.62;
                const lines = [String(labels[i] || '')];
                if (cfg.showValues) lines.push(val % 1 === 0 ? String(val) : val.toFixed(2));
                if (cfg.showPercent) lines.push((val / total * 100).toFixed(1) + '%');
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.font = 'bold 11px system-ui, sans-serif';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)';
                ctx.shadowBlur = 3;
                lines.forEach((line, li) => {
                    ctx.fillText(line, lx, ly + (li - (lines.length - 1) / 2) * 13);
                });
                ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
            }
            startAngle = endAngle;
        });
    }

    const legendEl = getOrCreateLegendEl(canvas);
    legendEl.innerHTML = labels.map((l, i) => {
        const isOff = hiddenSet.has(l);
        return `<span class="vanilla-legend-item${isOff ? ' legend-off' : ''}" data-label="${String(l).replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}" title="Cliquer pour masquer/afficher">
            <span class="vanilla-legend-dot" style="background:${colors[i] || '#3498db'}"></span>${l}
        </span>`;
    }).join('');
    if (cfg.onLegendClick) {
        legendEl.querySelectorAll('.vanilla-legend-item').forEach(item => {
            item.onclick = () => cfg.onLegendClick(item.getAttribute('data-label'));
        });
    }

    canvas.onclick = (e) => {
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const x = e.clientX - rect.left - cx;
        const y = e.clientY - rect.top - cy;
        if (Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y) > radius) return;
        let angle = Math.atan2(y, x);
        if (angle < -Math.PI / 2) angle += Math.PI * 2;
        const slice = slices.find(s => angle >= s.startAngle && angle <= s.endAngle);
        if (slice && cfg.onSliceClick) cfg.onSliceClick(slice.label);
    };

    const resizeHandler = () => drawPieChartVanilla(canvas, cfg);
    if (canvas._resizeHandler) window.removeEventListener('resize', canvas._resizeHandler);
    canvas._resizeHandler = resizeHandler;
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeHandler);

    return {
        _cleanup() {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resizeHandler);
            canvas.onclick = null;
            if (legendEl) legendEl.innerHTML = '';
        }
    };
}

/**
 * Graphique en courbes (multi-séries), 100% canvas natif.
 * cfg: { labels, datasets:[{label,data,color}], title }
 */
function drawLineChartVanilla(canvas, cfg) {
    const { ctx, width, height } = setupCanvasHiDPI(canvas);
    const labels = cfg.labels || [];
    const datasets = cfg.datasets || [];
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

    ctx.fillStyle = getCssVarValue('--text-primary', '#333');
    ctx.font = '600 14px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(cfg.title || '', width / 2, 20);

    const legendEl = getOrCreateLegendEl(canvas);

    if (!labels.length || !datasets.length) {
        ctx.fillStyle = getCssVarValue('--text-muted', '#999');
        ctx.font = '13px system-ui, sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText('Aucune donnée à afficher', width / 2, height / 2);
        legendEl.innerHTML = '';
        return { _cleanup() { legendEl.innerHTML = ''; } };
    }

    const padL = 52, padR = 20, padT = 34, padB = labels.length > 6 ? 55 : 34;
    const plotW = width - padL - padR;
    const plotH = height - padT - padB;

    let allValues = [];
    datasets.forEach(ds => { allValues = allValues.concat(ds.data || []); });
    if (!allValues.length) allValues = [0, 1];
    let minVal = Math.min(0, ...allValues);
    let maxVal = Math.max(...allValues, minVal + 1);
    const pad = (maxVal - minVal) * 0.1 || 1;
    minVal -= pad; maxVal += pad;

    const xStep = labels.length > 1 ? plotW / (labels.length - 1) : 0;
    const yScale = v => padT + plotH - ((v - minVal) / (maxVal - minVal)) * plotH;
    const xScale = i => labels.length > 1 ? padL + i * xStep : padL + plotW / 2;

    ctx.strokeStyle = getCssVarValue('--border-light', '#eee');
    ctx.fillStyle = getCssVarValue('--text-secondary', '#666');
    ctx.font = '11px system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const ticks = 5;
    for (let i = 0; i <= ticks; i++) {
        const v = minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * (i / ticks);
        const y = yScale(v);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(padL, y);
        ctx.lineTo(width - padR, y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillText(v % 1 === 0 ? v.toFixed(0) : v.toFixed(2), padL - 8, y + 4);
    }

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    labels.forEach((l, i) => {
        const x = xScale(i);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(x, padT + plotH + 16);
        if (labels.length > 6) { ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 5); ctx.textAlign = 'right'; }
        ctx.fillText(String(l), 0, 0);
        ctx.restore();
    });

    datasets.forEach(ds => {
        const data = ds.data || [];
        if (!data.length) return;
        ctx.beginPath();
        data.forEach((v, i) => {
            const x = xScale(i), y = yScale(v);
            if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
        });
        ctx.strokeStyle = ds.color || '#3498db';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.stroke();

        data.forEach((v, i) => {
            const x = xScale(i), y = yScale(v);
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(x, y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = ds.color || '#3498db';
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.strokeStyle = getCssVarValue('--bg-secondary', '#fff');
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.stroke();
        });
    });

    legendEl.innerHTML = datasets.map(ds => `
        <span class="vanilla-legend-item">
            <span class="vanilla-legend-dot" style="background:${ds.color || '#3498db'}"></span>${ds.label || ''}
        </span>
    `).join('');

    const resizeHandler = () => drawLineChartVanilla(canvas, cfg);
    if (canvas._resizeHandler) window.removeEventListener('resize', canvas._resizeHandler);
    canvas._resizeHandler = resizeHandler;
    window.addEventListener('resize', resizeHandler);

    return {
        _cleanup() {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', resizeHandler);
            legendEl.innerHTML = '';
        }
    };
}

/**
 * Structure complète de la sauvegarde globale
 */
function collectAllAppData() {
    return {
        // Métadonnées
        version: '16.0',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        appName: 'Calculateur Global Pro',
        
        // Notes et widget
        notes: notes || [],
        
        // Paramètres
        settings: settings || {},
        keyboardShortcuts: keyboardShortcuts || [],
        
        // Modes principaux
        calculator: {
            history: calcHistory || [],
            currentInput: document.getElementById('calc-input')?.value || ''
        },
        
        // Mode Tableaux
        tables: {
            list: tables || [],
            currentId: currentTableId,
            counter: tableCounter,
            numberingType: numberingType
        },
        
        // Mode C - Pourcentage
        modeC: {
            blocks: cBlocks || [],
            counter: cBlockCounter || 1
        },
        
        // Mode B - Budget
        modeB: {
            categories: budgetCategories || [],
            catCount: budgetCatCount || 1,
            globalBudget: document.getElementById('budget')?.value || '2000'
        },
        
        // Mode D - Évolution
        modeD: {
            dates: dDates || [],
            series: dSeries || [],
            useDates: document.getElementById('useDates')?.checked || true
        },
        
        // Mode F - Circulaire
        modeF: collectModeFData(),
        
        // Mode G - TVA
        modeG: collectModeGData(),
        
        // Mode H - Devises
        modeH: {
            conversionHistory: conversionHistory || [],
            lastFromCurrency: document.getElementById('fromCurrency')?.value || 'EUR',
            lastToCurrency: document.getElementById('toCurrency')?.value || 'USD'
        },
        
        // Mode A - Comparer
        modeA: collectModeAData(),
        
        // Calculs rapides
        quickCalculations: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CALC_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]'),
        
        // Statistiques et récents
        recentCalculations: recentCalculations || [],
        
        // États sauvegardés par mode
        savedStates: {
            modeA: modeASaves || [],
            modeB: modeBSaves || [],
            modeC: modeCSaves || [],
            modeD: modeDSaves || [],
            modeF: modeFSaves || [],
            modeG: modeGSaves || [],
            modeTable: modeTableSaves || []
        }
    };
}

/**

function collectModeFData() {
    return {
        groups: collectFGroupsList(),

    };
}

/**
 * Collecte les données du Mode A
 */
function collectModeAData() {
    const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('#multiAContainer .ref-block');
    return Array.from(blocks).map(block => ({
        ref: block.querySelector('.refA')?.value || '100',
        vals: block.querySelector('.valsA')?.value || '80 120 100'
    }));
}

/**
 * Collecte les données du Mode G
 */
function collectModeGData() {
    const blocks = document.querySelectorAll('#multiGContainer .ref-block');
    return Array.from(blocks).map(block => {
        const lines = Array.from(block.querySelectorAll('.ligne-tva')).map(line => ({
            id: line.id,
            libelle: line.querySelector('.libelleG')?.value || '',
            valeur: line.querySelector('.valeurG')?.value || '0',
            type: line.querySelector('.typeG')?.value || 'HT',
            tva: line.querySelector('.tvaIndividuelleG')?.value || '20'
        }));
        
        return {
            id: block.id,
            nom: block.querySelector('.bloc-nom-input')?.value || '',
            tvaGlobale: block.querySelector('.global-tva-input')?.value || '20',
            lignes: lines
        };
    });
}

/**
 * Affiche les statistiques des données
 */
function updateBackupStats() {
    const container = document.getElementById('backupStats');
    if (!container) return;
    
    const stats = [
        { label: 'Notes', count: notes?.length || 0, icon: 'sticky-note' },
        { label: 'Tableaux', count: tables?.length || 0, icon: 'table' },
        { label: 'Blocs %', count: cBlocks?.length || 0, icon: 'percentage' },
        { label: 'Catégories Budget', count: budgetCategories?.length || 0, icon: 'wallet' },
        { label: 'Séries Évolution', count: dSeries?.length || 0, icon: 'chart-line' },
        { label: 'Catégories Circulaire', count: document.querySelectorAll('#multiFContainer .ref-block').length || 0, icon: 'chart-pie' },
        { label: 'Blocs TVA', count: document.querySelectorAll('#multiGContainer .ref-block').length || 0, icon: 'receipt' },
        { label: 'Conversions', count: conversionHistory?.length || 0, icon: 'exchange-alt' },
        { label: 'Raccourcis', count: keyboardShortcuts?.length || 0, icon: 'keyboard' }
    ];
    
    let html = '';
    stats.forEach(stat => {
        if (stat.count > 0) {
            html += `
                <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-light);">
                    <i class="fas fa-${stat.icon}" style="color: var(--accent-color); margin-right: 5px;"></i>
                    <span style="font-weight: bold;">${stat.count}</span>
                    <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); display: block;">${stat.label}</span>
                </div>
            `;
        }
    });
    
    if (html === '') {
        html = '<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 20px;">Aucune donnée à sauvegarder</div>';
    }
    
    container.innerHTML = html;
}

/**
 * Crée une sauvegarde globale complète
 */
function createGlobalBackup(backupName = null) {
    const appData = collectAllAppData();
    
    // Compter le nombre total d'éléments
    const totalItems = Object.values(appData).reduce((sum, val) => {
        if (Array.isArray(val)) return sum + val.length;
        if (val && typeof val === 'object') {
            return sum + Object.values(val).filter(Array.isArray).reduce((s, arr) => s + arr.length, 0);
        }
        return sum;
    }, 0);
    
    const defaultName = `Sauvegarde_${new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}_${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR')}`;
    const name = backupName || prompt('Nom de la sauvegarde globale :', defaultName);
    
    if (!name) return;
    
    const backup = {
        id: Date.now(),
        name: name,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        data: appData,
        stats: {
            totalItems: totalItems,
            notes: appData.notes.length,
            tables: appData.tables.list.length,
            modes: Object.keys(appData.savedStates).length
        },
        size: JSON.stringify(appData).length
    };
    
    let backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
    backups.unshift(backup);
    
    // Garder seulement les 20 dernières sauvegardes
    if (backups.length > 20) backups = backups.slice(0, 20);
    
    localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(backups));
    displayBackupList();
    updateBackupStats();
    showNotification(`✅ Sauvegarde globale "${name}" créée (${totalItems} éléments)`, 'success');
}

/**
 * Restaure une sauvegarde globale complète
 */
function restoreGlobalBackup(backupId) {
    const backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
    const backup = backups.find(b => b.id === backupId);
    
    if (!backup) {
        showNotification('Sauvegarde introuvable', 'error');
        return;
    }
    
    const data = backup.data;
    const details = `
        📊 ${data.notes?.length || 0} notes
        📊 ${data.tables?.list?.length || 0} tableaux
        📊 ${data.modeC?.blocks?.length || 0} blocs %
        📊 ${data.modeB?.categories?.length || 0} catégories budget
        📊 ${data.modeD?.series?.length || 0} séries évolution
        📊 ${(Array.isArray(data.modeF) ? data.modeF.length : (data.modeF?.blocks?.length || 0))} catégories circulaire
        📊 ${data.modeG?.length || 0} blocs TVA
    `;
    
    if (confirmWithSetting(`Restaurer la sauvegarde "${backup.name}" ?\n${details}\n\nLes données actuelles seront écrasées.`)) {
        try {
            // Restaurer les notes
            if (data.notes) notes = data.notes;
            
            // Restaurer les paramètres
            if (data.settings) settings = { ...settings, ...data.settings };
            if (data.keyboardShortcuts) keyboardShortcuts = data.keyboardShortcuts;
            
            // Restaurer la calculatrice
            if (data.calculator) {
                calcHistory = data.calculator.history || [];
                const calcInput = document.getElementById('calc-input');
                if (calcInput && data.calculator.currentInput) {
                    calcInput.value = data.calculator.currentInput;
                }
            }
            
            // Restaurer les tableaux
            if (data.tables) {
                tables = data.tables.list || [];
                currentTableId = data.tables.currentId || null;
                tableCounter = data.tables.counter || 1;
                numberingType = data.tables.numberingType || 'numbers';
            }
            
            // Restaurer Mode C
            if (data.modeC) {
                cBlocks = data.modeC.blocks || [];
                cBlockCounter = data.modeC.counter || 1;
            }
            
            // Restaurer Mode B
            if (data.modeB) {
                budgetCategories = data.modeB.categories || [];
                budgetCatCount = data.modeB.catCount || 1;
                const budgetInput = document.getElementById('budget');
                if (budgetInput && data.modeB.globalBudget) {
                    budgetInput.value = data.modeB.globalBudget;
                }
            }
            
            // Restaurer Mode D
            if (data.modeD) {
                dDates = data.modeD.dates || [];
                dSeries = data.modeD.series || [];
                const useDates = document.getElementById('useDates');
                if (useDates && data.modeD.useDates !== undefined) {
                    useDates.checked = data.modeD.useDates;
                }
            }
            
            // Restaurer Mode F
            if (data.modeF) {
                restoreModeFData(data.modeF);
            }
            
            // Restaurer Mode G
            if (data.modeG) {
                restoreModeGData(data.modeG);
            }
            
            // Restaurer Mode H
            if (data.modeH) {
                conversionHistory = data.modeH.conversionHistory || [];
                const fromCurrency = document.getElementById('fromCurrency');
                const toCurrency = document.getElementById('toCurrency');
                if (fromCurrency && data.modeH.lastFromCurrency) {
                    fromCurrency.value = data.modeH.lastFromCurrency;
                }
                if (toCurrency && data.modeH.lastToCurrency) {
                    toCurrency.value = data.modeH.lastToCurrency;
                }
            }
            
            // Restaurer Mode A
            if (data.modeA) {
                restoreModeAData(data.modeA);
            }
            
            // Restaurer les calculs rapides
            if (data.quickCalculations) {
                localStorage.setItem(CALC_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.quickCalculations));
            }
            
            // Restaurer les calculs récents
            if (data.recentCalculations) {
                recentCalculations = data.recentCalculations;
            }
            
            // Restaurer les états sauvegardés
            if (data.savedStates) {
                modeASaves = data.savedStates.modeA || [];
                modeBSaves = data.savedStates.modeB || [];
                modeCSaves = data.savedStates.modeC || [];
                modeDSaves = data.savedStates.modeD || [];
                modeFSaves = data.savedStates.modeF || [];
                modeGSaves = data.savedStates.modeG || [];
                modeTableSaves = data.savedStates.modeTable || [];
            }
            
            // Sauvegarder tout immédiatement
            saveAllData();
            saveNotes();
            
            // Rafraîchir toutes les interfaces
            refreshAllInterfaces();
            
            showNotification(`✅ Sauvegarde "${backup.name}" restaurée avec succès`, 'success');
            
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Erreur restauration:', error);
            showNotification('❌ Erreur lors de la restauration', 'error');
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Restaure les données du Mode F (groupes + variables).
 * Compatible avec l'ancien format (simple tableau de blocs, sans groupes).
 */
function restoreModeFData(modeFData) {
    if (Array.isArray(modeFData)) {
        rebuildFZonesAndBlocks([], modeFData);
    } else if (modeFData && typeof modeFData === 'object') {
        rebuildFZonesAndBlocks(modeFData.groups || [], modeFData.blocks || []);
    }
}

/**
 * Restaure les données du Mode G
 */
function restoreModeGData(blocksData) {
    const container = document.getElementById('multiGContainer');
    if (!container) return;

    blocksData.forEach(blockData => {
        const blockId = blockData.id || 'gblock-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.className = 'ref-block';

            linesHTML += `
                <div class="ligne-tva" id="${ligneId}" style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap: wrap;">

                    <input type="number" class="valeurG" placeholder="Montant" value="${line.valeur}" style="width:110px;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
                    <select class="typeG" style="width:90px;" onchange="autoCalculG()">
                        <option value="HT" ${line.type === 'HT' ? 'selected' : ''}>HT</option>
                        <option value="TTC" ${line.type === 'TTC' ? 'selected' : ''}>TTC</option>
                    </select>
                    <input type="number" class="tvaIndividuelleG" placeholder="TVA (%)" value="${line.tva}" style="width:80px;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
                    <button onclick="removeNode(this)" class="delete-btn" style="padding: 5px 10px;"><i class="fas fa-times"></i></button>
                </div>
            `;
        });
        
        div.innerHTML = `
            <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; flex-wrap: wrap;">
                <input type="text" class="bloc-nom-input" value="${blockData.nom}" placeholder="Nom du bloc" style="flex:1; min-width: 200px;" oninput="autoCalculG()">
                <label style="color: var(--text-primary); white-space: nowrap;">TVA Globale (%): <input type="number" class="global-tva-input" value="${blockData.tvaGlobale}" style="width:70px;" oninput="autoCalculG()"></label>
                <button onclick="addGLigneToBlock('${blockId}')" class="secondary"><i class="fas fa-plus"></i> Ligne</button>
                <button onclick="removeNode(this)" class="delete-btn"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i></button>
            </div>
            <div class="ligneGContainer" style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:15px;">
                ${linesHTML}
            </div>
        `;
        
        container.appendChild(div);
    });
}

/**
 * Rafraîchit toutes les interfaces après restauration
 */
function refreshAllInterfaces() {
    // Rafraîchir les calculs
    updateCalcHistoryDisplay();
    updatePreview();
    
    // Rafraîchir les tableaux
    renderTableTabs();
    renderCurrentTable();
    
    // Rafraîchir les modes
    renderCBlocks();
    updateCResults();
    renderBudgetCategories();
    updateBudgetRecap();
    updateDTable();
    calculerD();
    autoCalculF();
    calculerF();
    calculerG();
    autoCalculA();
    
    // Rafraîchir les listes de sauvegardes
    displayModeASaves();
    displayModeBSaves();
    displayModeCSaves();
    displayModeDSaves();
    displayModeFSaves();
    displayModeGSaves();
    displayTableSavesList();
    
    // Rafraîchir les devises
    if (typeof convertCurrency === 'function') {
        updateFlags();
        convertCurrency();
    }
    
    // Rafraîchir les notes
    renderNotes();
    
    // Rafraîchir le dashboard
    updateDashboard();
    
    // Appliquer les paramètres
    loadSettings();
    
    // Réactiver les inputs améliorés
    enhanceNumberInputs();
    
    // Sauvegarder l'état
    saveAllData();
    saveNotes();
}

/**
 * Exporte la sauvegarde courante vers un fichier
 */
function exportGlobalBackup() {
    const backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
    
    if (backups.length === 0) {
        showNotification('Aucune sauvegarde à exporter', 'warning');
        return;
    }
    
    // Demander quelle sauvegarde exporter
    const backupNames = backups.map((b, index) => `${index + 1}. ${b.name} (${new Date(b.timestamp).toLocaleDateString()})`).join('\n');
    const choice = prompt(`Quelle sauvegarde exporter ? (Entrez le numéro)\n\n${backupNames}`, '1');
    
    if (!choice) return;
    
    const index = parseInt(choice) - 1;
    if (index >= 0 && index < backups.length) {
        const backup = backups[index];
        
        const dataStr = JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2);
        const dataUri = 'data:application/json;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(dataStr);
        const fileName = `calculateur_${backup.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_')}_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
        
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = dataUri;
        link.download = fileName;
        link.click();
        
        showNotification(`Sauvegarde "${backup.name}" exportée`, 'success');
    } else {
        showNotification('Numéro invalide', 'error');
    }
}

/**
 * Importe une sauvegarde depuis un fichier
 */
function importGlobalBackupFile() {
    const input = document.createElement('input');
    input.type = 'file';
    input.accept = '.json';
    
    input.onchange = function(event) {
        const file = event.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;
        
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = function(e) {
            try {
                const importedData = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
                
                // Vérifier si c'est une sauvegarde complète ou une ancienne sauvegarde
                if (importedData.data && importedData.name && importedData.timestamp) {
                    // C'est une sauvegarde complète
                    if (confirmWithSetting(`Importer la sauvegarde "${importedData.name}" ?`)) {
                        let backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
                        backups.unshift(importedData);
                        localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(backups));
                        displayBackupList();
                        showNotification('Sauvegarde importée avec succès', 'success');
                    }
                } else if (importedData.notes || importedData.tables || importedData.modeC) {
                    // C'est une sauvegarde de données directe, la convertir en sauvegarde complète
                    const newBackup = {
                        id: Date.now(),
                        name: `Import_${new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}`,
                        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                        data: importedData,
                        stats: {
                            totalItems: Object.keys(importedData).length,
                            notes: importedData.notes?.length || 0,
                            tables: importedData.tables?.list?.length || 0
                        },
                        size: JSON.stringify(importedData).length
                    };
                    
                    if (confirmWithSetting(`Convertir et importer ces données ?`)) {
                        let backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
                        backups.unshift(newBackup);
                        localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(backups));
                        displayBackupList();
                        showNotification('Données importées et converties en sauvegarde', 'success');
                    }
                } else {
                    showNotification('Format de fichier non reconnu', 'error');
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Erreur import:', error);
                showNotification('Erreur lors de l\'importation', 'error');
            }
        };
        reader.readAsText(file);
    };
    
    input.click();
}

/**
 * Affiche la liste des sauvegardes avec plus de détails
 */
function displayBackupList() {
    const container = document.getElementById('backupList');
    if (!container) return;
    
    const backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
    
    if (backups.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
            <div style="text-align: center; padding: 40px 20px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-2x" style="margin-bottom: 15px;"></i>
                <p>Aucune sauvegarde disponible</p>
                <p style="font-size: 12px;">Créez votre première sauvegarde globale</p>
            </div>
        `;
        return;
    }
    
    let html = '';
    backups.forEach(backup => {
        const date = new Date(backup.timestamp).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
        const size = (backup.size / 1024).toFixed(2);
        const items = backup.stats?.totalItems || '?';
        
        html += `
            <div style="background: var(--bg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 8px; padding: 15px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px;">
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 5px;">
                            <i class="fas fa-database" style="color: var(--accent-color); margin-right: 5px;"></i>
                            ${backup.name}
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted);">
                            ${date} • ${size} Ko • ${items} éléments
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="display: flex; gap: 5px;">
                        <button onclick="restoreGlobalBackup(${backup.id})" class="secondary" style="padding: 8px 12px;" title="Restaurer">
                            <i class="fas fa-undo"></i>
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="exportSingleBackup(${backup.id})" class="secondary" style="padding: 8px 12px;" title="Exporter">
                            <i class="fas fa-download"></i>
                        </button>
                        <button onclick="deleteBackup(${backup.id})" class="delete-btn" style="padding: 8px 12px;" title="Supprimer">
                            <i class="fas fa-trash"></i>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Aperçu rapide du contenu -->
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11px;">
                    ${backup.stats?.notes ? `<span style="background: var(--bg-tertiary); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 12px;"><i class="fas fa-sticky-note"></i> ${backup.stats.notes}</span>` : ''}
                    ${backup.stats?.tables ? `<span style="background: var(--bg-tertiary); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 12px;"><i class="fas fa-table"></i> ${backup.stats.tables}</span>` : ''}
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    });
    
    container.innerHTML = html;
    updateBackupStats();
}

/**
 * Exporte une sauvegarde spécifique
 */
function exportSingleBackup(backupId) {
    const backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
    const backup = backups.find(b => b.id === backupId);
    
    if (!backup) {
        showNotification('Sauvegarde introuvable', 'error');
        return;
    }
    
    const dataStr = JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2);
    const dataUri = 'data:application/json;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(dataStr);
    const fileName = `calculateur_${backup.name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_')}_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
    
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = dataUri;
    link.download = fileName;
    link.click();
    
    showNotification(`Sauvegarde "${backup.name}" exportée`, 'success');
}

/**
 * Supprime une sauvegarde
 */
function deleteBackup(backupId) {
    if (confirmWithSetting('Supprimer cette sauvegarde ?')) {
        const backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
        const updatedBackups = backups.filter(b => b.id !== backupId);
        localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedBackups));
        displayBackupList();
        showNotification('Sauvegarde supprimée', 'success');
    }
}

/**
 * Supprime toutes les sauvegardes
 */
function clearAllBackups() {
    if (confirmWithSetting('Supprimer TOUTES les sauvegardes ? Cette action est irréversible.')) {
        localStorage.removeItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY);
        displayBackupList();
        showNotification('Toutes les sauvegardes ont été supprimées', 'success');
    }
}

/**
 * Gère l'import d'un fichier de sauvegarde
 */
function handleBackupFileSelect(event) {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = function(e) {
        try {
            const importedData = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
            
            if (importedData.data && importedData.name && importedData.timestamp) {
                if (confirmWithSetting(`Importer la sauvegarde "${importedData.name}" ?`)) {
                    let backups = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
                    backups.unshift(importedData);
                    localStorage.setItem(BACKUP_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(backups));
                    displayBackupList();
                    showNotification('Sauvegarde importée avec succès', 'success');
                }
            } else {
                showNotification('Format de fichier non reconnu', 'error');
            }
        } catch (error) {
            showNotification('Erreur lors de l\'importation', 'error');
        }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
}

// FONCTIONS DU MENU LATÉRAL

function toggleSidebar() {
    sidebarCollapsed = !sidebarCollapsed;
    const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const toggleBtn = document.querySelector('.toggle-btn i');
    
    if (sidebar) {
        if (sidebarCollapsed) {
            sidebar.classList.add('collapsed');
            if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.className = 'fas fa-chevron-right';
        } else {
            sidebar.classList.remove('collapsed');
            if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.className = 'fas fa-chevron-left';
        }
    }
    
    localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebarCollapsed);
}

function setActiveMenuItem(element) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item').forEach(item => {
        item.classList.remove('active');
    });
    element.classList.add('active');
    const modeTitle = element.querySelector('span')?.textContent || 'Accueil';
    const titleEl = document.getElementById('currentModeTitle');
    if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = modeTitle;
}

// ============================================
// FONCTION PRINCIPALE D'AFFICHAGE DES MODES
// ============================================
function showMode(modeId) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.mode-content').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.add('hidden');
    });
    
    if (modeId !== 'none' && document.getElementById(modeId)) {
        document.getElementById(modeId).classList.remove('hidden');
        
        const menuItems = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-item');
        let found = false;
        
        menuItems.forEach(item => {
            const onclick = item.getAttribute('onclick');
            if (onclick && onclick.includes(modeId)) {
                item.classList.add('active');
                const modeTitle = item.querySelector('span')?.textContent || 'Accueil';
                const titleEl = document.getElementById('currentModeTitle');
                if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = modeTitle;
                found = true;
            } else {
                item.classList.remove('active');
            }
        });
        
        if (!found && modeId === 'home') {
            const homeItem = document.querySelector('.menu-item[onclick*="home"]');
            if (homeItem) homeItem.classList.add('active');
            const titleEl = document.getElementById('currentModeTitle');
            if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = 'Accueil';
        }
        
        // Initialisations spécifiques avec affichage automatique
        if (modeId === 'modeC') {
            if (cBlocks.length === 0) addCBlock();
            else {
                renderCBlocks();
                updateCResults();
            }
        }
        if (modeId === 'modeH') {
            loadExchangeRates();
            displayModeHSaves();
        }
        if (modeId === 'modeF') {
            autoCalculF();
            displayModeFSaves();
        }
        if (modeId === 'modeD') {
            updateDTable();
            calculerD();
            displayModeDSaves();
        }
        if (modeId === 'home') updateDashboard();
        if (modeId === 'modeB') {
            if (budgetCategories.length === 0) addBudgetCategory();
            else {
                renderBudgetCategories();
                updateBudgetRecap();
            }
            displayModeBSaves();
        }
        if (modeId === 'modeA') {
            if (document.querySelectorAll('#multiAContainer .ref-block').length === 0) addABlock();
            else autoCalculA();
            displayModeASaves();
        }
        if (modeId === 'modeG') {
            if (document.querySelectorAll('#multiGContainer .ref-block').length === 0) addGBlock();
            else calculerG();
            displayModeGSaves();
        }
        if (modeId === 'modeTableau') {
            renderTableTabs();
            if (currentTableId) renderCurrentTable();
            displayTableSavesList();
        }
        if (modeId === 'modeCalculs') updateCalculations();
        
        const notesPanel = document.getElementById('notesPanel');
        if (notesPanel) notesPanel.classList.remove('active');
        saveAllData();
    }
}
